description:
**Introduction**  


Welcome to Gallagher in India — where expertise, technology, and purpose come together. Since 2006, Gallagher in India has supported global teams by delivering quality, service, and speed through deep expertise, smart technology, and specialized knowledge services. More than just an operations center, it’s a place where careers grow through collaboration, continuous learning, and purposeful work. We drive efficiency, compliance, and innovation so our teams can focus on serving clients. If you enjoy solving problems and working with purpose, Gallagher is the place where you can grow and feel a sense of belonging.
  

**Overview**  

The **Business Analyst – Talent Acquisition Technical Support** role is integral to Gallagher’s global Talent Acquisition Center of Excellence (CoE), focusing on streamlining and optimizing recruitment processes through technical support and leadership. This position is pivotal in enhancing the efficiency, productivity, and quality of talent acquisition technologies by providing expert guidance and support. The role involves collaborating with HRIS, recruiters, TA leadership, and other operational support groups to ensure the smooth operation and optimization of recruiting technologies and processes. The ideal candidate will effectively navigate a large, complex organization, adapt swiftly to changing circumstances, and proactively address challenges as Gallagher continues to grow its global presence by attracting top talent.


We are seeking a proactive and detail\-oriented **Business Analyst** to manage and optimize our talent acquisition technologies through technical support and leadership. This role is crucial for ensuring the seamless operation and integration of our recruitment systems. The position involves partnering with HRIS and other internal stakeholders to drive compliance and efficiency in our talent acquisition processes. Additionally, the Business Analyst will be responsible for training and partnering with other Business Analysts Key Responsibilities within TA and HR to ensure consistent processes and maintaining documentation to support these efforts. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, effectively prioritizes tasks, thinks creatively to solve problems, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity.

  

  

**How you'll make an impact** **Key Responsibilities:*** Partner with TA, HR, HRIS, IT, and vendors to understand objectives, align priorities, and serve as a liaison for recruiting technologies.
* Elicit, document, and translate business requirements/user stories; perform process mapping and recommend optimizations/automation.
* Manage TA technology ecosystem (e.g., ATS, CRM, career site/portal, VMS, LinkedIn, AI/chatbots) in partnership with internal teams and vendors.
* Plan and execute testing (UAT, regression, smoke), assess release impacts, and coordinate deployment and communications.
* Develop and maintain documentation (BRDs, process flows, SOPs, job aids, test scripts, change logs) with proper version control and audit readiness.
* Build dashboards/reports, analyze data to identify trends and insights, and communicate findings to stakeholders and leadership.
* Lead initiatives end\-to\-end: scope, plan, track, and deliver projects; manage risks/issues/changes and ensure timely, quality outcomes.
* Prioritize work based on regulatory, financial, and customer impact; escalate and resolve blockers swiftly.
* Define and execute the TA technology training strategy and roadmap with HRIS/TA leadership.
* Create and govern training assets (role\-based curricula, QRGs, SOPs, e\-learning/microlearning, FAQs, troubleshooting guides).
* Deliver and scale enablement (live virtual/in\-person sessions, office hours, self\-paced modules, train\-the\-trainer) for end users across regions/roles.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Measure and improve adoption and proficiency using feedback and metrics (attendance, retention, time\-to\-proficiency, ticket volumes, usage analytics).
* Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs and objectives.
* Gather and analyze data from multiple sources to identify trends, patterns, and insights.
* Develop reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings and recommendations.
* Conduct business process analysis and recommend process improvements and optimizations.
* Define and document business requirements for new initiatives or projects.
* Work with HRIS and IT teams to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Support project management activities, including project planning, tracking, and reporting.
* Provide ongoing support and training to end users on business intelligence tools and systems.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends and best practices in business analysis and data analytics.
* Design, deliver, and scale role\-based training for end users and stakeholders (live, virtual, and self\-paced) to drive adoption of BI/TA systems, new features, and best practices.
* Build and maintain training assets and knowledge base content (SOPs, quick reference guides, job aids, FAQs), and measure effectiveness to continuously improve enablement.
  


  

**About you** **Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Computer Science, or related field
* 5\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or similar role
* 3\+ years in a training or development role
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills


  

**Additional Information**  

At Gallagher, we believe supporting our colleagues goes far beyond the role itself. For more information, visit our Benefits page.* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive benefits programs designed to support your well\-being
* Career development opportunities and ongoing learning

title: UI/UX Design Intern
description:
**About Us**

At **V7 AI Solutions LLP**, we are passionate about building AI that understands, learns, and acts on real\-world problems responsibly. Our mission is to unlock the full potential of artificial intelligence—intelligent, adaptive, autonomous, and ethical—while creating solutions that transform industries, empower organisations, and improve human lives.

At V7 AI, you will be part of a **dynamic, fast\-growing environment** where curiosity, creativity, and collaboration are highly valued. Working five days a week from our Bengaluru office (9:30 AM – 7:00 PM) allows our team to learn from each other, brainstorm ideas in real time, and build products faster and smarter.

**About the Role**

As a UI/UX Design Intern at V7 AI Solutions, you will work closely with designers, product managers, business analysts, and developers to create intuitive, user\-centric digital experiences for web and mobile applications.

You will contribute to real\-world projects — designing wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and interaction flows — while collaborating with cross\-functional teams to translate requirements into thoughtful design solutions.

This internship is designed for individuals who want hands\-on exposure to end\-to\-end product design, design systems, UX research, and AI\-assisted design workflows. You will contribute to real design cycles while learning how fast\-growing product teams build scalable, structured design processes.

This role is highly execution\-oriented and requires strong visual thinking, attention to detail, and a genuine eagerness to learn.

**Qualifications**

* Basic understanding of UI/UX principles, design thinking, and user\-centred design.
* Familiarity with Figma — components, auto layout, variants, and prototyping.
* Knowledge of user flows, wireframing, information architecture, and responsive design.
* Basic familiarity with FigJam, AI\-powered design tools, and accessibility best practices.
* Strong problem\-solving, attention to detail, and willingness to learn.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Freshers and students are welcome. Academic projects, personal UI/UX work, or a portfolio are a strong plus.
* Interest in SaaS, AI, Healthcare, or startup products is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**

UX Design \& Wireframing

* Assist in creating wireframes, user flows, and prototypes for web and mobile applications.
* Develop and document user flows, web flows, and interaction flows.
* Create user\-centric designs that focus on usability, accessibility, and intuitive experiences.
* Contribute to solving user and business problems through thoughtful design solutions.

UI Design \& Design Systems

* Support UI design activities across web and mobile platforms.
* Assist in developing and maintaining design systems and reusable components.
* Create and maintain design documentation using Figma and FigJam.

Research \& Collaboration

* Participate in user research, competitor analysis, and design discussions.
* Work with product and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into design solutions.
* Participate in design reviews and improve designs based on structured feedback.

AI\-Assisted Design

* Use AI tools to support research, ideation, content generation, and wireframing.
* Explore opportunities to integrate AI\-powered design tools into existing workflows.

**Work Style Expectations**

* AI\-assisted design processes

At V7 AI Solutions, you will work in a fast\-moving environment where your design contribution directly impacts product quality and user experience.

title: Senior RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
  

Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos
  
  

Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream.

* Basic programming skills in Python and/or C\+\+
* Understanding of basic robotics concepts: kinematics, sensors, and control
* Willingness to work hands\-on with hardware and learn on the job
* Good problem\-solving attitude and eagerness to learn in a startup environment

**PREFERRED / GOOD TO HAVE**

* Exposure to Linux/Ubuntu environment

*Saleshandy* *is a SaaS platform helping sales teams at thousands of companies reach more prospects and close more deals. We are growing \- and growing means hiring. *This is a role for someone who wants to own outcomes \- and understands that every great hire is a direct contribution to our growth story.*

**What You'll Actually Own**


*End\-to\-End Recruitment*

* Own the full hiring pipeline for each role \- sourcing, screening, coordination, and offer roll\-out
* Hire across functions: technical (engineering, QA, product, data) and non\-technical (sales, marketing, operations, customer success)

* Build real relationships with candidates, not transactional pipelines
* Ensure every candidate who interacts with Saleshandy leaves with a positive impression \- regardless of outcome  

  

*Hiring Operations \& Data*
* Keep Gohire updated, accurate, and insightful \- hiring data should tell a story, not just track stages
* Maintain hiring dashboards, pipeline reports, and offer documentation with precision
* Track your own metrics: time\-to\-hire, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance rate \- before anyone asks you to  

  

*SaaS Hiring Intelligence*
* Develop a deep understanding of the B2B SaaS talent landscape
* Know what a great SDR looks like vs. a great AM, what a backend engineer from a product startup brings vs. a services background
* Stay plugged into where the right people are \- and go find them

**What You Bring**

* Demonstrated ability to hire across functions \- tech and non\-tech, junior and senior
* Genuine curiosity about the SaaS industry \- you follow the space, you understand the roles
* Hunter mentality in sourcing \- you are not waiting for applications
* Strong interpersonal skills \- you build relationships, not just pipelines
* Data\-driven by default \- you track your numbers without being asked
* High energy and resilience \- recruiting is emotionally complex and fast\-moving, and you handle it professionally

**Why This Role Matters**


You will be the engine behind Saleshandy's growth \- ensuring every team gets the right people, fast. With 50\+ roles open and a mandate that only grows, your work directly shapes who we become as a company.

 Milliman is undertaking a major business transformation program to replace and modernize our HRIS, Finance, Legal, and Professional Services Automation systems. As part of the Data Enablement Team, we are seeking a Data \& Application Integration Engineer to support the integrity, quality, and migration of data throughout this transformation. This role will work alongside senior engineers and business/technical teams, contributing to data mapping, migration, validation, and integration activities to enable a smooth transition to new enterprise platforms. This is a great opportunity for someone early\-to\-mid in their integration engineering career to grow their skills on a large\-scale enterprise transformation.

 Role details

description:

We're OakNorth, and we embolden entrepreneurs to realise their ambitions, understand their markets, and apply data intelligence to everyday decisions to scale successfully at pace. We go beyond finance to empower our people, encourage professional growth, and create an environment where everyone can thrive.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**


The Corporate Finance team sits at the heart of OakNorth's financial operations, covering reporting, planning, and control across our UK and international entities. The team works closely with FP\&A, Treasury, Legal, Operations, and the business to ensure robust financial governance and continuous process improvement.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**


We are looking for an experienced Finance Controllership professional to join our Corporate Finance team. In this role you will own end\-to\-end accounting and reporting across both internal and external requirements — working under IFRS and Indian GAAP — while leading a broad array of planning projects and process improvement initiatives that directly support OakNorth's growth ambitions.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Own day\-to\-day accounting, month\-end closing, and periodic reporting in accordance with IFRS and Indian GAAP.
* Manage end\-to\-end accounting, valuation, and bank reconciliations for complex financial instruments including Investments, Borrowings, Loans, Deposits, and Derivatives (hedging compliance).
* Prepare Balance Sheet and P\&L items including prepayments, accruals, depreciation runs, intercompany entries, and other month\-end journals.
* Lead Fixed Assets and Intangible accounting, related schedules, and physical verifications; maintain General Ledger, vendor, and bank reconciliations.
* Support Statutory and Internal audits, preparing schedules, responding to auditor queries, and drafting internal notes/memos for approvals and audit evidence.
* Drive process standardisation and automation using data tools and AI\-enabled solutions in treasury and accounting workflows; draft and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (FP\&A, Operations, Legal, Credit/Portfolio Monitoring, Treasury, and the business) to identify process improvement opportunities and enhance the control environment.
* Prepare test scenarios and perform testing for system automation projects; assist with ad hoc projects as required.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* CA (Fresher)/CPA/MBA in Finance with 4–5 years of progressive experience demonstrating strong accounting expertise and advanced financial analytical skills.
* Strong Microsoft Excel and MS Office skills with a focus on reporting automation; ability to prioritise and manage multiple workflows simultaneously.
* Excellent verbal and written communication and interpersonal skills, with experience working across multiple functions and geographies in a fast\-paced organisation.
* Self\-driven, proactive, and results\-oriented mindset with a continuous improvement outlook; comfortable operating at scale with a hands\-on attitude and big\-picture thinking.

**Nice to Have**

* Background in the banking or financial services sector.
* Experience with or interest in data automation tools such as Python/Pandas or VBA for automating reconciliations and reporting processes.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Health \& Protection:** Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* **Wellbeing:** Annual health check\-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* **Time Off:** Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* **Life Milestones:** Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* **Flexible Benefits:** Tax\-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* **Growth \& Development:** Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* **Our Workplace:** Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

**About Caarabi:**

Caarabi is a specialty coffee brand built on the belief that good coffee doesn't need to shout. We roast, we serve, we ship — across a growing network of outlets and a direct\-to\-consumer business. Our brand is quiet, considered, and unmistakable. Nothing about it is over\-designed or try\-hard.

We're looking for someone who gets that — and can carry it forward.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an enthusiastic, organized, and detail\-oriented **Customer \& Dispatch Coordinator** (Entry\-Level / Fresher) to join our operations team. In this role, you will assist in day\-to\-day order processing, coordinate with logistics partners, track shipments, and serve as the primary link between our customers and our fulfilment backend. If you have exceptional communication skills, a proactive attitude, and an eager interest in e\-commerce and customer operations, this is a great opportunity to build your career in a growing brand.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Order Fulfilment \& Processing**

* Assist in processing daily D2C (Shopify) and B2B orders.
* Assist in Print shipping labels, verify invoices, and coordinate with the warehouse team for accurate packing.
* Ensure daily dispatch target timelines are met.

**2\. Shopify Backend Support**

* Assist in updating order statuses, tracking numbers, and fulfillment records in the backend system.
* Assist with maintaining clean daily logs for dispatched and pending orders.
* Assist with basic inventory updates and stock alignment.

**3\. Logistics \& Dispatch Tracking**

* Liaise with courier partners to schedule daily pickups and resolve handover delays.
* Monitor live shipments, track transit status, and assist in identifying non\-delivery reports (NDR).
* Follow up on delayed or stuck packages to ensure prompt delivery.

**4\. Customer Communication \& Support**

* Respond promptly to customer inquiries via WhatsApp, email, and phone regarding order status, delivery timelines, and product information.
* Provide proactive delivery updates and handle basic customer concerns with warmth and empathy.
* Coordinate return/exchange requests with the warehouse team.

**5\. Process \& Administrative Assistance**

* Assist in maintaining daily operational spreadsheets and delivery tracking sheets.
* Assist seniors in preparing basic logistics and dispatch reports.

**Skills \& Qualifications**

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline (Freshers are encouraged to apply).
* **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Hindi.
* **Technical Skills:** Basic proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets and comfort learning software tools (Shopify, courier portals).
* **Attributes:** High attention to detail, strong problem\-solving mindset, punctuality, and a customer\-first attitude.
* **Interest:** Keen interest in direct\-to\-consumer (D2C) operations, logistics, or the specialty coffee industry.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Success in this role will be measured by:

* Reduction in order Return to Origin (RTO) percentage
* Amount of failed delivery (NDR) shipments successfully rescued
* Number of non\-delivery alerts called within 3 hours
* Timeliness and accuracy of daily order dispatches
* Speed and consistency of customer call/chat responses
* Accuracy of master tracking sheet and backend inventory logs

Please send your resume to **careers@caarabicoffee.com** with the subject line: **"Customer \& Dispatch Coordinator \- \[Your name]"**.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of **Instagram Reels, social media trends, video content, shoot planning, and visual storytelling**. You should be comfortable handling shoots from concept to execution and coordinating with clients, models, videographers, photographers, and the internal creative team.

* Good understanding of camera angles, framing, lighting, and video storytelling.
* Confidence in managing and directing shoots.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work with clients and creative teams.
* Good knowledge of current social media trends.
* Ability to multitask and work in a fast\-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in content creation, social media, shoot management, or a digital marketing agency is preferred.
* Portfolio or previous work in Reels, brand shoots, product shoots, or social media content will be an advantage.
* Freshers with strong creativity, confidence, and practical knowledge of social media content may also apply.

Who Should Apply?

You’ll be a good fit if you:

* Love creating content and exploring new ideas.
* Enjoy being involved in shoots and production.
* Can confidently manage people and coordinate a shoot.
* Understand what makes content engaging on social media.

title: ETP Operator
description:
ETP \& BIOFILTER OPERATOR

**Company:** Collagen Marine Products  
**Location:** Kakkadampoyil Plant  
**Department:** ETP \& Environmental Management  
**Position:** ETP \& Biofilter Operator  
**Reporting To:** ETP / Production In\-Charge or Production Manager

1\. Job Purpose

The ETP \& Biofilter Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation, monitoring, and basic maintenance of the Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) and Biofilter system. The operator shall ensure that wastewater and odour\-control systems are functioning properly and that treatment activities are carried out as per company procedures, environmental requirements, and Pollution Control Board norms.

2\. Key Responsibilities

* Operate and monitor the ETP and Biofilter systems on a daily basis.
* Start, stop, and monitor pumps, blowers, aerators, agitators, dosing systems, filters, clarifiers, and other ETP equipment.
* Monitor important operating parameters such as **pH, flow, temperature, dissolved oxygen (DO), TDS, COD/BOD\-related readings**, as applicable.
* Ensure proper chemical preparation, dosing, and safe handling of treatment chemicals.
* Monitor biological treatment processes and maintain suitable operating conditions for effective treatment.
* Operate and monitor the Biofilter system to control and reduce odour generated from the production/effluent treatment areas.
* Check blower operation, air flow, spray/nozzle systems, moisture levels, media condition, and other Biofilter parameters.
* Regularly inspect tanks, pipelines, valves, pumps, blowers, filters, and other equipment for leakage, blockage, abnormal noise, or malfunction.
* Collect wastewater and treated\-water samples as instructed and assist in laboratory testing.
* Maintain daily ETP and Biofilter **log sheets, operating records, chemical consumption records, and maintenance records**.
* Record abnormalities, breakdowns, process deviations, and corrective actions taken.
* Ensure proper handling, dewatering, storage, and disposal of sludge as per company procedures.
* Maintain cleanliness and housekeeping of the ETP and Biofilter areas.
* Carry out routine preventive maintenance and minor operational adjustments where authorized.
* Immediately report major equipment failures, unusual odour, leakage, overflow, abnormal discharge, or treatment problems to the concerned supervisor.
* Ensure treated effluent is maintained within applicable statutory and company requirements before discharge/reuse.
* Support Pollution Control Board inspections, environmental audits, sampling, and compliance activities.
* Assist in maintaining statutory/environmental records required for inspections and compliance.
* Follow all SOPs, safety instructions, PPE requirements, and chemical\-handling procedures.
* Coordinate with the Production, Maintenance, Quality, and EHS teams whenever required.
* Perform any other ETP/environment\-related duties assigned by the Production Manager or management.

3\. Biofilter\-Specific Responsibilities

* Monitor the Biofilter continuously during operation.
* Ensure adequate airflow through the Biofilter system.
* Monitor moisture/wetting of the Biofilter media as required.
* Check for clogging, channeling, excessive pressure drop, or deterioration of filter media.
* Ensure proper operation of associated pumps, blowers, spray systems, ducts, and valves.
* Monitor odour\-control performance and immediately report abnormal odour conditions.
* Maintain records of Biofilter operation, inspection, cleaning, and maintenance.
* Assist in replacement or servicing of Biofilter media when required.

4\. Safety \& Environmental Responsibilities

* Wear appropriate PPE while operating the ETP and handling chemicals.
* Follow chemical storage, dilution, dosing, and emergency procedures.
* Never bypass or alter treatment systems without authorization.
* Prevent chemical spills, untreated effluent discharge, and environmental contamination.
* Keep emergency equipment and access areas clear.
* Report unsafe conditions and incidents immediately.
* Maintain good housekeeping around the ETP and Biofilter area.

5\. Required Skills \& Qualifications

**Minimum Qualification:**  
10th / 12th / ITI / Diploma in a relevant technical, environmental, chemical, mechanical, or related field.

**Experience:**

* Freshers with relevant technical knowledge may be considered.
* Experience in ETP/STP/WTP/Biofilter operation or industrial wastewater treatment will be preferred.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Basic knowledge of wastewater treatment processes.
* Basic knowledge of pumps, blowers, valves, aerators, filters, and dosing systems.
* Ability to take and record plant readings accurately.
* Basic understanding of pH and water\-quality parameters.
* Ability to identify abnormal operating conditions.
* Basic maintenance and troubleshooting skills.
* Willingness to work in shifts, if required.
* Good discipline, housekeeping, and safety awareness.

6\. Performance Expectations

The operator is expected to:

* Maintain continuous and stable ETP operation.
* Ensure proper functioning of the Biofilter and effective odour control.
* Maintain accurate daily operational records.
* Minimize equipment downtime through timely reporting and basic preventive maintenance.
* Ensure safe chemical handling and proper housekeeping.
* Support compliance with applicable environmental and Pollution Control Board requirements.
* Immediately escalate any abnormality that may affect treatment efficiency or environmental compliance.

title: RPA Developer - Core
description:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
  
Job Summary
  
  

About the Role
  
  

We are looking for a GenAI Agentic Developer to design, build, integrate, test, and support intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, tool\-calling workflows, autonomous agents, and agentic AI frameworks. The role requires strong programming fundamentals, practical exposure to GenAI application development, and the ability to connect LLMs with enterprise data sources, APIs, workflow systems, vector databases, and cloud\-based AI services. The candidate should be able to contribute to AI assistants, chatbots, knowledge search solutions, document intelligence use cases, automation agents, and production\-ready GenAI features with appropriate controls for accuracy, reliability, safety, cost, and performance.
  
  

This role is suitable for candidates with 1 to 4 years of relevant experience . Freshers or entry\-level candidates should demonstrate strong project, internship, certification, GitHub, hackathon, academic, or portfolio\-based exposure in Python, GenAI, LLM applications, RAG pipelines, prompt engineering, vector search, chatbot development, AI\-assisted automation, or agentic workflow prototypes.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Develop GenAI applications using Python, LLM APIs, prompt engineering, RAG patterns, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI frameworks.
  
Build AI agents capable of reasoning, planning, tool calling, function calling, workflow orchestration, memory usage, task decomposition, and multi\-step execution.
  
Design and implement RAG and Agentic RAG pipelines using document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata tagging, embeddings, vector indexing, semantic search, hybrid retrieval, reranking, prompt construction, and grounded response generation.
  
Integrate GenAI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources such as documents, databases, SharePoint repositories, knowledge bases, APIs, ticketing systems, and workflow platforms.
  
Implement prompt templates, system prompts, reusable prompt libraries, structured outputs, JSON response formats, prompt versioning, and output validation logic.
  
Create tool integrations that allow agents to call APIs, execute workflows, retrieve data, summarize content, classify information, generate reports, and trigger downstream actions safely.
  
Support model selection and configuration based on use case needs such as accuracy, latency, context window, token usage, cost, privacy, and deployment constraints.
  
Integrate LLMs with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, knowledge repositories, search services, and automation workflows.
  
Use frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or similar tools to build agentic workflows.
  
Create reusable components for prompt templates, tool integrations, retrieval workflows, memory handling, guardrails, model evaluation, tracing, observability, and monitoring.
  
Perform testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for factual accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, groundedness, safety, bias, latency, token usage, cost, and reliability.
  
Implement basic Responsible AI and security controls such as input validation, prompt injection mitigation, PII handling, access control, auditability, and safe response handling.
  
Support deployment and integration of GenAI components into backend services, web applications, automation workflows, and cloud\-hosted environments.
  
Support testing and evaluation of GenAI outputs for accuracy, relevance, hallucination control, latency, cost, safety, and reliability.
  
Collaborate with data engineers, backend developers, cloud engineers, QA teams, product owners, and business stakeholders to deliver AI\-enabled features.
  
Document prompts, agent flows, API integrations, model configurations, assumptions, limitations, and deployment steps.
  
Skill Requirements
  
  

Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  

Strong programming capability in Python , including data structures, APIs, object\-oriented programming, exception handling, logging, debugging, package management, and modular application development.
  
Hands\-on exposure to Generative AI, Large Language Models, prompt engineering, embeddings, tokenization, context windows, structured outputs, and AI application development .
  
Working knowledge of RAG architecture , including document processing, chunking strategies, metadata design, vectorization, semantic search, hybrid search, reranking, context augmentation, and grounded response generation.
  
Experience or strong project exposure in agentic AI concepts such as tool calling, function calling, planning, memory, reflection, reasoning loops, task decomposition, autonomous execution, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and workflow orchestration.
  
Exposure to frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI , or equivalent agentic development frameworks.
  
Experience integrating LLMs through APIs or cloud AI services such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic APIs, or open\-source model endpoints.
  
Working knowledge of vector databases or semantic search platforms such as FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search, or pgvector.
  
Understanding of REST APIs, JSON, authentication, backend integration, data ingestion, and application deployment basics.
  
Working knowledge of Git, code reviews, debugging practices, documentation, and Agile delivery methods.
  
  

Preferred / Additional Skills
  
  

Exposure to cloud\-native AI services, especially AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI, or Gemini APIs.
  
Familiarity with multi\-agent systems, supervisor\-agent patterns, planner\-executor workflows, human\-in\-the\-loop flows, and agent evaluation methods.
  
Knowledge of LLMOps or GenAIOps practices, including prompt versioning, model configuration management, monitoring, tracing, evaluation, and cost tracking.
  
Exposure to OCR, document intelligence, NLP, text classification, summarization, entity extraction, and enterprise knowledge search use cases.
  
Basic understanding of model evaluation metrics, hallucination reduction, grounded responses, guardrails, responsible AI, privacy, and security controls.
  
Experience with FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Node.js, or similar tools for building AI\-enabled applications and demos.
  
Other Requirements
  
  

Experience Criteria
  
  

1 to 4 years of relevant experience in GenAI development, AI application engineering, Python development, ML/NLP application development, backend development, or automation engineering.
  
  

Educational Qualifications
  
  

**Mandatory Qualification:**  

B.E. / B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electronics, Software Engineering, or any other relevant engineering stream

title: Documentation Officer
description:
**Job Title:** Documentation \& Compliance Officer

**Company:** Back to Village (B2V)

**Department:** HR

**Reporting To:** Management

**Location:** Ranchi (Jharkhand)

**About Back to Village (B2V)**

Back to Village (B2V) is an organization dedicated to climate\-smart farming, rural community development, and sustainable livelihood generation. Operating across multiple states from its headquarters in Ranchi, B2V bridges field\-level agricultural innovation with scalable community empowerment initiatives.

**Role Summary**

As the Documentation \& Compliance Officer at Back to Village (B2V), you will lead the end\-to\-end statutory compliance, legal documentation, and institutional record\-keeping. You will ensure B2V strictly adheres to all social sector regulations while maintaining high\-quality documentation for CSR partners, donor reports, government bodies, and internal programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Statutory \& NGO Compliance**

* Oversee and maintain all organizational compliance under Indian law, including Society/Trust registrations, 12A, 80G, CSR\-1, and NITI Aayog Darpan portal, etc.
* Manage filings, renewals, and legal documentation related to FCRA, PF, ESI, and local state regulations.
* Coordinate with legal counsel, CAs, and auditors to prepare compliance filings, statutory disclosures, and annual returns.
* Ensure all organizational contracts, MoUs, partnership agreements, and NDAs are legally sound, vetted, and properly archived.

**2\. Project \& Donor Documentation**

* Standardize and manage project reporting templates for field teams of all projects.
* Compile, edit, and deliver timely, high\-quality progress reports, impact stories, case studies, and utilization reports for CSR donors and grantors.
* Maintain a centralized digital repository of all project proposals, grant agreements, field data, and media assets.
* Draft formal correspondence with government agencies, district authorities, and community leaders.

**3\. Internal Policy \& Audit Management**

* Update, and implement internal operational policies (e.g., POSH, Child Safeguarding, Code of Ethics, Procurement Policy).
* Conduct quarterly internal documentation audits to verify that field and administrative teams adhere to organizational processes.
* Assist external audit teams during project\-specific or organizational financial/social audits.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **100% Statutory Compliance:** Zero delays, penalties, or compliance notices from regulatory authorities.
* **On\-Time Donor Reporting:** 100% deadline adherence for all monthly/quarterly donor and CSR impact reports.
* **Documentation Audit Score:** \>95% accuracy in central document archiving and record retrieval efficiency.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LL.B), Public Policy, Master of Social Work (MSW), or Business Administration.
* **Experience:** Minimum 3 years of experience in documentation, compliance management, or legal affairs within an NGO, social enterprise, or developmental advisory firm.
* **Domain Knowledge:** Strong understanding of Indian NGO legal frameworks (12A/80G, CSR rules under Companies Act, FCRA, NITI Aayog guidelines).
* **Skills:** Exceptional written communication and editing skills in English and Hindi; strong analytical ability; proficiency in Google Workspace and digital document management tools.
* **Attributes:** Meticulous attention to detail, strong ethical grounding, and the ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced environment.

**Application Process:**

Interested candidates should submit their updated Resume/CV along with a Cover Letter outlining relevant experience to careers@backtovillage.org with the subject line "Application: HR \& Admin Manager" and fill this form: https://forms.gle/YYm8LosViNJRD5Wz8

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time

* Manage vendor onboarding, service\-level agreements (SLAs), lease renewals, and utility payments.
* Oversee/assist monthly payroll processing, employee attendance/leave records, and expense reimbursements.
* Assist management in Implementing administrative policies and internal control systems.

* Train and mentor the Executive to ensure accuracy in data entry, filing, vendor handling, and guest management.

* 100% on\-time tax filings and error\-free statutory compliance (Zero penalty record).
* Accurate monthly financial reporting delivered by the designated deadline.
* Smooth office operations with optimal utility/vendor spend management.
* High accuracy in payroll processing and timely employee expense settlement.

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Commerce (B.Com / M.Com) or Finance.

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced **HR Manager** to manage and oversee the complete Human Resources function for our textile manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **factory HR, manpower management, recruitment, employee relations, statutory compliance, payroll coordination, performance management, and labour\-related matters**.

The candidate should be comfortable working in a manufacturing environment and managing both **workmen and staff**.

Key Responsibilities1\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning

* Plan and manage manpower requirements for production and support functions.
* Handle recruitment, selection, onboarding, and induction of employees.
* Develop effective sources for recruiting skilled, semi\-skilled, and unskilled workforce.
* Maintain manpower records and monitor absenteeism, turnover, and manpower productivity.

2\. Factory HR \& Employee Relations

* Manage day\-to\-day HR activities at the textile manufacturing unit.
* Maintain positive employee relations and address employee grievances.
* Handle disciplinary matters in accordance with company policies and applicable labour laws.
* Coordinate with production and other department heads on workforce\-related issues.
* Support employee engagement and retention initiatives.

3\. Labour Law \& Statutory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirements.
* Manage statutory registers, records, licences, notices, and documentation.
* Coordinate PF, ESI, Bonus, Gratuity, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare and other applicable compliances.
* Coordinate labour inspections, audits, and statutory submissions.
* Ensure compliance with applicable factory and employment regulations.

4\. Payroll \& Attendance

* Supervise attendance, leave, overtime, shift, and wage\-related processes.
* Coordinate monthly payroll processing and ensure accuracy.
* Monitor contract labour attendance, wages, documentation, and compliance.
* Resolve payroll and attendance\-related employee queries.

5\. Performance \& Employee Development

* Implement and monitor performance appraisal processes.
* Identify training and development requirements.
* Coordinate skill development, employee training, and induction programmes.
* Support career development and succession planning initiatives.

6\. HR Policies \& Administration

* Develop and implement HR policies and procedures.
* Maintain accurate employee personnel records and HR documentation.
* Prepare HR MIS reports covering manpower, absenteeism, attrition, overtime, recruitment, and other key metrics.

JOB DESCRIPTION: Mumbai Business Head / Senior Client Servicing \& Operations Head

About the Company

It is a Mumbai\-based corporate events, experiential marketing and brand activation agency servicing some of India's leading brands, including Audi, Škoda, Samsung, Tata Motors and other marquee corporates.

Our business is primarily focused on **brand activations and experiential marketing**, along with corporate events, conferences, launches, dealer meets and employee engagement programs.

The Opportunity

The Company is looking for an experienced **Mumbai Business Head / Senior Client Servicing \& Operations Head** to take complete ownership of the Mumbai business.

This is a **hands\-on leadership role**, responsible for managing key client relationships, leading the servicing and operations function, overseeing project delivery, and ensuring that the Mumbai team consistently delivers high\-quality, commercially viable projects.

Approximately **75% of the business is activation\-led**, with the balance comprising corporate events and other experiential projects. Therefore, strong experience in **brand activations, BTL, experiential marketing and on\-ground execution** is essential.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Client Servicing \& Relationship Management

* Take senior\-level ownership of key client accounts and relationships.
* Act as the escalation point for important client requirements and issues.
* Understand client marketing objectives and translate briefs into effective activation and experiential solutions.
* Build strong, long\-term relationships with Marketing Heads, Brand Managers, Trade Marketing teams, Corporate Communications and other key stakeholders.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, account growth and cross\-selling.

2\. Activation \& Project Leadership

* Lead the end\-to\-end servicing and execution of brand activation projects.
* Oversee projects from brief receipt and planning through execution and closure.
* Ensure that concepts are translated into practical, executable and commercially viable solutions.
* Supervise multiple projects simultaneously across locations.
* Personally oversee critical and high\-value on\-ground executions whenever required.
* Ensure delivery within agreed timelines, budgets and quality standards.

3\. Operations Leadership

* Lead the Mumbai servicing and operations team.
* Allocate resources and ensure accountability across projects.
* Establish strong project management and execution processes.
* Work closely with production, creative, vendors and finance teams.
* Ensure timely resolution of operational challenges and client escalations.
* Build a reliable vendor and execution ecosystem across fabrication, manpower, logistics, technology and other activation requirements.

4\. Commercial \& Financial Responsibility

* Review project budgets, costing and commercials to ensure healthy margins.
* Work closely with the management team on pricing and commercial negotiations.
* Monitor project profitability and control unnecessary costs.
* Ensure timely billing, documentation and project closure.
* Take ownership of commercial outcomes for projects under the Mumbai operation.

5\. Team Leadership

* Lead, mentor and develop the Mumbai Client Servicing and Operations team.
* Set clear performance expectations and ensure delivery accountability.
* Build a culture of ownership, responsiveness and client\-first thinking.
* Identify gaps in team capability and recommend hiring or resource requirements.

6\. Business Development Support

* While this is primarily a Client Servicing \& Operations leadership role, the candidate will be expected to actively contribute to business growth.
* Leverage existing client relationships and industry network to identify new opportunities.
* Participate in important pitches, credentials presentations and client meetings.
* Work closely with the Business Development team to convert opportunities into executable projects.
* Help strengthen Gloria World's presence within the Mumbai corporate and marketing ecosystem.

Ideal Candidate

* **10–15 years of relevant experience** in Client Servicing, Operations, Experiential Marketing, Brand Activations, BTL or Corporate Events.
* Strong experience in **brand activations / experiential marketing**, preferably with at least 5\+ years in activation\-led businesses.
* Experience managing marquee corporate clients and multi\-location campaigns.
* Proven ability to independently manage large and complex projects from brief to execution.
* Strong understanding of production, fabrication, manpower, logistics, permissions and on\-ground execution.
* Excellent client relationship and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong commercial understanding, including costing, negotiation and project profitability.
* Demonstrated team leadership experience.
* Excellent communication, presentation and problem\-solving skills.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced agency environment with tight deadlines and demanding clients.
* Willingness to travel as required for project execution.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate is **not merely a senior account manager**. We are looking for someone who can function as the **owner of the Mumbai operation** — someone who can independently handle clients, lead the servicing and operations teams, solve execution challenges, protect margins and ensure that every project is delivered to a high standard.

A candidate with a strong combination of **Activation \+ Client Servicing \+ Operations leadership** will be preferred over someone coming purely from corporate events.

**Job Title:** Telecaller – Real Estate Sales **Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana **Department:** Sales \& Business Development **Reports To:** Sales Manager / Team Lead **Employment Type:** Full\-time (Work from Office)

**Role Summary:**

We are looking for a dynamic and target\-driven **Telecaller** to join our real estate sales team in Gurgaon. The primary role is to generate leads, qualify prospects, and schedule site visits for residential/commercial projects in Gurgaon (e.g., Golf Course Road, Sohna, Dwarka Expressway, New Gurgaon). You will be the first point of contact for potential brokers and investors.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make **100–120\+ New outbound calls daily** to potential buyers or brokers from provided databases, past inquiries, and marketing campaigns.
* Introduce ongoing and upcoming real estate projects (apartments, floors, villas, commercial spaces) in Gurgaon micro\-markets.
* Qualify leads based on budget, preferred location, possession timeline, and investment intent.
* Fix **site visits** and appointments with the sales team.
* Follow up consistently with warm leads (cold leads to be nurtured over 15–30 days).
* Maintain accurate call logs, lead status, and follow\-up reminders in **CRM software**.
* Achieve weekly/monthly KPIs: calls made, connects, qualified leads, visits fixed, broker onboarding and closures assisted.
* Handle inbound inquiries from digital ads, social media, and property portals (e.g., 99acres, Magicbricks, Square Yards).
* Provide basic project information – pricing, floor plans, possession date, RERA registration, amenities, and payment plans.
* Overcome basic objections and redirect serious leads to senior sales executives for negotiation.
* Calling to all database provided by company

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* **Language Proficiency:** Fluency in Hindi (mandatory), English (good to have), and Haryanvi/Punjabi (plus).
* **Communication:** Clear, confident, and persuasive phone manner.
* **Local Knowledge:** Basic understanding of Gurgaon sectors, landmarks, real estate micro\-markets, and price trends.
* **Sales Acumen:** Ability to identify serious buyers vs. price shoppers.
* **Resilience:** Comfortable with rejections and aggressive daily call targets.
* **Tech Savvy:** Basic MS Excel, CRM and WhatsApp Business.
* **Result\-oriented:** Hungry for incentives and monthly closures.

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Minimum **1 year of telecalling experience** (real estate, financial services, or B2C sales preferred).
* Freshers with strong communication skills and local area knowledge may be considered.
* Education: 12th pass or graduate (any stream).
* Must have own reliable smartphone and basic internet (work from office however requires digital logins).
* Should be willing to work **6 days a week** (Tuesday off as per company policy).
* Previous experience in calling for real estate projects on Dwarka Expressway.

**What We Offer (Compensation \& Benefits)**

* **Fixed Salary:** **18k \- 25k** per month (depending on experience and communication skills).
* **Performance Incentives:**
* ₹500 per site visit conversion (unique visit)
* As per revenue sharing slab decided by the Company.
* Monthly bonus for exceeding lead\-to\-visit targets.
* **Travel allowance** for any fieldwork (if required very rarely).
* **On\-job training** on project USPs, objection handling, and CRM.
* **Growth path:** Telecaller → Senior Telecaller → Team Lead – Inside Sales (within 12–18 months).

**Work Environment (Gurgaon Specific)**

* Office location: Sector 106, Dwarka Expressway Gurgaon.
* Working hours: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM.
* Dress code: Semi\-formal / Business casuals for office and occasional RWA meets (if caller accompanies sales team).

description:
Office ManagerJob Overview

We are looking for a proactive, organised, and dependable **Office Manager** to take ownership of the day\-to\-day administration and smooth functioning of our office.

The Office Manager will be responsible for office facilities, vendors, supplies, maintenance, employee coordination, documentation, expenses, and general administration.

The ideal candidate should be someone who can identify problems, take ownership, and get things resolved without requiring constant follow\-up from management.

Key ResponsibilitiesOffice Administration

* Manage the day\-to\-day functioning of the office.
* Ensure the office remains clean, organised, professional, and fully operational.
* Coordinate with employees regarding general office and administrative requirements.
* Maintain office records, documents, agreements, invoices, and administrative files.
* Manage incoming and outgoing couriers, parcels, and documents.
* Coordinate visitors, meetings, conference rooms, and internal office requirements.
* Manage employee access cards, keys, lockers, seating arrangements, and related requirements.

Facilities \& Maintenance

* Ensure all office facilities are functioning properly, including:
* Air conditioning
* Electricity
* Internet and Wi\-Fi
* Lighting
* Plumbing
* Furniture
* Office equipment
* Pantry facilities
* Security systems
* Coordinate repairs and maintenance with electricians, plumbers, AC technicians, carpenters, IT technicians, and other vendors.
* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules for important office equipment.
* Coordinate with building management, landlords, society, or facility\-management teams where required.
* Ensure office issues are resolved quickly with minimum disruption to employees.

Vendor Management

* Identify and coordinate with suitable vendors for office requirements.
* Obtain and compare quotations before major purchases or services.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms with vendors.
* Maintain a database of approved vendors.
* Monitor vendor quality and service levels.
* Track AMC contracts, service agreements, warranties, and renewal dates.

Office Purchases \& Supplies

* Manage stationery, pantry supplies, cleaning materials, office equipment, and other consumables.
* Maintain adequate stock levels while avoiding unnecessary purchases.
* Coordinate procurement of laptops, mobile phones, furniture, and other office equipment when required.
* Maintain records of company assets issued to employees.

Expenses \& Payments

* Maintain accurate records of office\-related expenses.
* Verify vendor invoices before submitting them for payment.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for timely payments.
* Monitor recurring expenses such as electricity, internet, rent, maintenance, telephone, and subscriptions.
* Prepare monthly office expense reports for management.
* Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary administrative expenses.

Employee Support

* Coordinate workstation readiness for new employees.
* Support HR with onboarding arrangements and employee documentation where required.
* Assist employees with office\-related issues and requirements.
* Coordinate employee travel, hotel bookings, taxis, and local transportation when required.
* Support internal events, employee celebrations, meetings, and company activities.

Housekeeping \& Security

* Supervise housekeeping staff and ensure cleanliness standards are maintained.
* Coordinate security staff and visitor\-management processes.
* Ensure common areas, washrooms, meeting rooms, workstations, and pantry areas are properly maintained.
* Monitor housekeeping and security attendance and performance.

Asset Management

* Maintain an updated company asset register.
* Track laptops, mobile phones, furniture, equipment, access cards, and other company property.
* Record asset allocation and returns during employee joining and exit.
* Coordinate repairs or replacement of damaged equipment.

Documentation \& Compliance

* Maintain office\-related agreements, invoices, quotations, licences, AMC contracts, and vendor documents.
* Ensure important renewals and payments are completed on time.
* Support management and HR with basic office compliance requirements.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and employee information.

Key Areas of Ownership

* Office administration
* Facilities management
* Vendor management
* Maintenance and repairs
* Housekeeping and security
* Office supplies
* Office expenses
* Company assets
* Employee workplace support
* Documentation
* Building and landlord coordination

Key KPIs

* Resolution time for office issues
* Office maintenance standards
* Vendor performance
* Office expense control
* Accuracy of asset records
* Timely payment and renewal of office services
* Availability of office supplies
* Employee satisfaction with workplace facilities
* Housekeeping and facility standards
* Reduction in unnecessary administrative expenses

Requirements

* 3–6 years of experience in office administration, office management, facilities management, or a similar role.
* Strong organisational and multitasking skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple vendors and service providers.
* Good negotiation and communication skills.
* Strong follow\-up and problem\-solving ability.
* Comfortable working with Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets.
* Ability to maintain expense trackers, vendor records, and asset registers.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced and growing organisation.

Preferred Experience

* Experience managing an office of 30–100\+ employees.
* Experience in a startup, D2C, e\-commerce, healthcare, FMCG, retail, or technology company.
* Experience managing office fit\-outs, renovations, relocations, or expansion projects.
* Experience managing housekeeping, security, and facility staff.
* Experience negotiating with vendors and contractors.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Hospitality, or a related field preferred.

title: Senior HR Manager
description:
Job Description:

**Job Brief \-**

We are seeking an experienced and strategic Senior Human Resources Manager to lead and oversee the HR operations of our hospitality group. With over 400 employees across multiple departments and locations, the Senior HR Manager will be responsible for driving people strategy, ensuring compliance, strengthening organizational culture and leading talent development.

This role requires a proactive leader with deep expertise in hospitality HR, strong interpersonal skills and the ability to create scalable people systems that support business growth.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**. HR Strategy \& Leadership \-**

Develop and execute the HR strategy aligned with the company’s mission, culture and growth plans.

. Drive organizational development initiatives to ensure operational efficiency and employee satisfaction.

. Serve as the key advisor to senior leadership on all HR and workforce\-related matters.

**. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning \-**

. Lead end\-to\-end recruitment for all levels (from frontline staff to senior positions).

. Create long\-term manpower planning for all departments including F\&B, Front Office, Housekeeping, Culinary, Operations, Admin, Finance, Maintenance, etc.

. Oversee induction and onboarding processes to ensure seamless integration of new hires.

. Build strong pipelines for seasonal and peak\-season hiring.

**. Employee Relations \& Workplace Culture \-**

. Foster a positive, inclusive and high\-performance work environment.

. Implement employee engagement programs, feedback systems and culture\-building activities.

. Oversee conflict resolution, disciplinary actions and grievance management fairly and confidentially.

. Ensure the company’s values, service standards and customer\-first culture are reflected in all teams.

**. Training \& Development \-**

. Create comprehensive training calendars across hospitality functions including service excellence, grooming, communication, leadership, compliance and skill enhancement.

. Collaborate with department heads to identify training needs and performance gaps.

. Manage staff development plans, mentorship programs and succession planning.

. Evaluate training effectiveness and implement improvements.

**. Performance Management \-**

. Lead annual and quarterly performance review cycles.

. Design KPIs, appraisal frameworks and promotion guidelines tailored to hospitality operations.

. Ensure consistency and transparency in evaluations and reward systems.

. Coach managers on performance conversations and team management.

**. Compensation, Payroll \& Benefits Oversight \-**

. Coordinate with finance for accurate monthly payroll processing.

. Develop competitive salary structures and benefits packages appropriate for hospitality roles.

. Manage overtime, roster systems, attendance records and fair shift scheduling.

. Review and update compensation policies regularly.

**. HR Operations \& Policy Management \-**

. Develop, update, and enforce HR policies, SOPs, handbooks and compliance protocols.

. Ensure legal compliance with labor laws, audits, workplace safety norms and statutory requirements (PF, ESIC, gratuity, minimum wages, POSH, etc.).

. Maintain accurate employee records and HR documentation across all locations.

. Implement HRMS/HRIS systems to streamline operations.

**. Employee Welfare, Safety \& Compliance \-**

. Ensure a safe, respectful and harassment\-free workplace.

. Drive POSH committee activities and awareness training.

. Support accommodation, transport, health \& safety and welfare needs of staff.

. Oversee medical checkups, safety drills and occupational health standards that are crucial in hospitality.

**. Leadership \& Team Management \-**

. Lead and mentor the HR team across recruitment, training, payroll and operations.

. Ensure strong coordination with department heads to support daily operational needs.

. Build a culture of accountability, teamwork and continuous improvement within HR.

**. Required Skills \& Competencies \-**

. Strong knowledge of hospitality operations and workforce dynamics.

. Excellent communication, interpersonal and conflict\-solving skills.

. Deep understanding of labor laws, statutory compliance and HR documentation.

. Strong leadership and team management abilities.

. Strategic thinking with hands\-on operational capability.

. Proficient in HRMS systems, payroll software and MS Office.

. High emotional intelligence and professionalism.

**. Education \& Qualifications \-**

. Master’s degree in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Organizational Behavior, or related field (preferred).

. Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or related domain (mandatory).

. Certifications in HR, labor law, L\&D, or organizational development are an added advantage.

. Minimum 7–10 years of HR management experience, with at least 3–5 years in hospitality or a similar service\-led industry.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹75,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided

Work Location: In person

description:
**Job Description: HR Recruiter**  
Company: CasaNode LLP  
Location: Mumbai, India (On\-site)  
Employment Type: Full\-time  
Experience: 3–5 years in recruitment (technical/engineering hiring preferred)

**About CasaNode**

CasaNode LLP is a Mumbai\-based home and building automation company and an authorised Casambi smart\-lighting partner. We design and deliver intelligent lighting, KNX, and integrated automation solutions for residential, commercial, and hospitality projects. As we scale, we're building a team of engineers, project specialists, and sales professionals who share our passion for smart technology.

**Role Overview**  
We are looking for an HR Recruiter to own end\-to\-end hiring across technical and non\-technical roles. You will partner closely with leadership to understand hiring needs, build talent pipelines, and deliver a great candidate experience — helping CasaNode grow with the right people.

**Key Responsibilities**  
Manage the full recruitment lifecycle: sourcing, screening, scheduling, interviewing coordination, offer negotiation, and onboarding  
Draft and post job descriptions on portals (Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed) and manage employer branding on these platforms  
Source candidates for technical roles (automation engineers, KNX/Casambi programmers, electrical/ELV technicians) and business roles (sales, project coordination, accounts)  
Conduct initial telephonic/HR screening rounds and assess candidate fit on skills, salary expectations, and notice period  
Maintain an organised candidate database and recruitment tracker (Excel/ATS)  
Coordinate interviews between candidates and hiring managers; follow up promptly at every stage  
Handle offer letters, documentation, background verification, and joining formalities  
Support basic HR operations: attendance, leave records, and employee engagement activities as needed  
Build relationships with consultants, colleges, and industry networks for ongoing talent pipelines

**Requirements**  
Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, or related field  
1–3 years of recruitment experience; experience hiring for engineering, electrical, ELV, or building\-automation roles is a strong plus  
Hands\-on experience with job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter) and Boolean search  
Strong communication skills in English and Hindi (Marathi a plus)  
Well\-organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced, growing company  
Proficiency in MS Excel / Google Sheets for trackers and reports  
Nice to Have  
Exposure to HR generalist functions (payroll coordination, compliance basics)  
Familiarity with the lighting, automation, AV, or construction/MEP industry

**What We Offer**  
Opportunity to shape the HR function at a growing automation brand  
Direct exposure to leadership and fast decision\-making  
Competitive salary commensurate with experience  
Learning exposure to the smart\-building and IoT industry

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹100,000\.00 \- ₹400,000\.00 per year

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Andheri, Mumbai, Maharashtra: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person
