title: HR Executive
description:
Job Description – HR Executive

**Company:** Happi FoodTech Pvt. Ltd. (Happidli)  
**Industry:** Food \& Beverage / QSR  
**Location:** Kalyan, Maharashtra  
**Work Location:** Happidli Office, Kalyan  
**Role:** HR Executive  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years

About Happidli

Happidli is a growing South Indian food brand bringing authentic Karnataka\-style breakfast and snacks to Mumbai.

With company\-owned and franchise outlets, a Central Kitchen, and plans for rapid expansion across Mumbai and surrounding areas, we are building a scalable food business driven by **authentic food, strong processes, trained teams, and technology**.

We are looking for an **HR Executive** who can take ownership of day\-to\-day HR operations and help us build a strong, disciplined, and people\-focused organisation as we grow.

Role Overview

The HR Executive will be responsible for managing the complete employee lifecycle at Happidli — from **recruitment and onboarding to attendance, payroll, documentation, employee engagement, performance coordination, and exit formalities**.

The ideal candidate should be highly organised, approachable, proactive, and comfortable working with both **office employees and frontline F\&B staff** across outlets and the Central Kitchen.

This is a **hands\-on generalist HR role** where you will be expected to execute, improve systems, and solve day\-to\-day people\-related challenges.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Recruitment \& Hiring

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment for outlet, Central Kitchen, delivery, support, and office roles.
* Understand manpower requirements from Operations and other departments.
* Prepare and publish job postings across relevant platforms.
* Source candidates through job portals, references, local networks, social media, and employee referrals.
* Screen candidates and conduct initial HR interviews.
* Coordinate interviews with department/store managers.
* Maintain an active candidate database and recruitment pipeline.
* Coordinate offer discussions, selection, and joining formalities.
* Ensure manpower requirements are closed within defined timelines.
* Develop local hiring channels around Mumbai and other operating locations.

2\. Employee Onboarding

* Manage joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Collect and verify required employee documents.
* Create employee records and maintain accurate HR databases.
* Issue offer letters, appointment letters, and other HR documents.
* Coordinate induction and orientation for new employees.
* Ensure employees understand company policies, attendance rules, salary structure, work expectations, and basic SOPs.
* Coordinate employee uniforms, ID cards, access, and other joining requirements.

3\. Attendance \& Payroll

* Maintain accurate employee attendance records across outlets, Central Kitchen, and office.
* Track late coming, absenteeism, weekly offs, leave, overtime, and other attendance\-related matters.
* Coordinate monthly payroll preparation with Finance/Management.
* Verify attendance and salary inputs before payroll processing.
* Maintain records of salary advances, deductions, incentives, overtime, and other adjustments.
* Resolve employee queries related to salary and attendance.
* Maintain payroll\-related documentation and records.

4\. HR Documentation \& Records

* Maintain complete and updated employee files.
* Maintain employee master data and HR trackers.
* Manage documentation related to joining, transfers, promotions, salary revisions, warnings, disciplinary actions, and exits.
* Maintain leave and attendance records.
* Ensure all employees have the required documentation on file.
* Maintain confidentiality of employee and company information.
* Keep HR records organised and readily accessible for audits and internal requirements.

5\. Employee Relations

* Act as the first point of contact for routine employee concerns and HR\-related queries.
* Build a positive and professional relationship with outlet and Central Kitchen staff.
* Understand employee concerns and coordinate their resolution with management.
* Address absenteeism, discipline, behavioural issues, and workplace conflicts appropriately.
* Conduct regular employee check\-ins where required.
* Help build a culture of accountability, respect, teamwork, and ownership.

6\. Performance \& Employee Management

* Coordinate employee performance review processes.
* Maintain records of employee performance and feedback.
* Support managers in documenting performance issues and improvement plans.
* Track probation periods and confirmation timelines.
* Coordinate promotions, salary revisions, transfers, and role changes.
* Help identify high\-performing employees and retention risks.

7\. Training \& Development

* Coordinate joining and induction training.
* Work with Operations to ensure employees complete required operational and food\-service training.
* Maintain training records.
* Track employee training completion and refresher training requirements.
* Support the creation of basic training calendars and HR development initiatives.

8\. Employee Engagement \& Retention

* Develop simple employee engagement initiatives suitable for a growing QSR business.
* Organise employee recognition and appreciation activities.
* Track employee feedback and identify recurring people\-related issues.
* Work with management to improve employee retention and workplace satisfaction.
* Help build a culture where frontline employees feel valued and connected to the Happidli brand.

9\. Exit \& Full \& Final Process

* Manage resignation and exit formalities.
* Conduct or coordinate exit interviews.
* Coordinate notice period, handover, asset recovery, and clearance processes.
* Prepare exit documentation and coordinate Full \& Final settlement with Finance.
* Maintain accurate employee separation records.
* Analyse reasons for attrition and highlight recurring concerns to management.

10\. HR Policies \& Process Building

* Help create and maintain practical HR policies for Happidli.
* Establish standard processes for hiring, onboarding, attendance, leave, payroll, disciplinary actions, and exits.
* Continuously improve HR processes as the organisation grows.
* Help implement HR tools, software, trackers, and automation wherever useful.
* Ensure HR processes are consistently followed across outlets and the Central Kitchen.

11\. Compliance \& Statutory HR Support

* Maintain records required for applicable labour and employment compliance.
* Coordinate with external consultants/accountants where required for statutory HR matters.
* Support documentation related to applicable PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Shops \& Establishment and other requirements, as applicable.
* Ensure HR documentation and processes are maintained in an audit\-ready manner.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The HR Executive will be measured on:

* **Hiring TAT:** Positions closed within agreed timelines.
* **Manpower Availability:** Required staffing maintained across outlets and CK.
* **Employee Documentation:** 100% employee records complete and updated.
* **Payroll Accuracy:** Minimum payroll errors and timely processing.
* **Attendance Accuracy:** Accurate and timely attendance records.
* **Employee Retention:** Reduction in avoidable employee attrition.
* **Probation Tracking:** 100% timely follow\-up on probation/confirmation.
* **Training Completion:** Required employee training completed on schedule.
* **Employee Grievance Resolution:** Timely resolution and escalation of employee concerns.
* **HR Process Compliance:** Consistent implementation of HR policies and processes.

Candidate ProfileMust Have

* 1–3 years of experience in HR, preferably as an HR Executive/HR Generalist.
* Experience handling recruitment and employee documentation.
* Basic understanding of payroll and attendance management.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good command of English and Hindi; Marathi would be an advantage.
* Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and basic HR software/tools.
* Strong organisational and follow\-up skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership.
* Willingness to work closely with frontline employees and operational teams.

Preferred

* Experience in **F\&B, QSR, retail, hospitality, restaurants, or other frontline\-heavy businesses**.
* Experience hiring blue\-collar/frontline employees.
* Experience handling multi\-location employees.
* Familiarity with HRMS/payroll systems.
* Basic understanding of labour laws and statutory compliance.
* Experience building HR processes in a growing company/startup.

Personal Attributes We Value

We are looking for someone who is:

* **People\-oriented** but firm when required.
* Highly organised and detail\-oriented.
* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions.
* Comfortable speaking with both management and frontline employees.
* Good at follow\-ups and closing tasks.
* Practical and solution\-oriented.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-growing environment where processes are still evolving.
* Trustworthy and capable of handling confidential information.
* Willing to get their hands dirty and work closely with the actual business.

What You Will Get to Build

This is not just a role of maintaining HR records.

As Happidli grows, you will have the opportunity to help build the **HR function from the ground up** — including recruitment systems, employee databases, payroll processes, onboarding systems, training coordination, performance management, employee engagement, and HR technology.

You will work closely with the founders and Operations team and play an important role in building the **people and culture behind Happidli's expansion**.

**Reporting To:** Management / Founders  
**Location:** Kalyan, Maharashtra  
**Role Type:** Full\-Time, On\-Site

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹20,000\.00 per month

Experience:

* Human resources management: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

Location:

* Kalyan, Maharashtra (Kalyan) (Preferred)

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


Capgemini is seeking a Director level executive to join the HR and Employee Experience team. This person will lead a team of 15 consultants and scale the team aggressively in terms of headcount and sales.


The candidate should have a sales and leadership mindset; the firm seeks a strong leader who can articulate a vision, and also drive execution of that vision in a very concrete manner that results in tangible business outcomes (bookings, contribution margin, revenue, market recognition).


The role demands a high level of autonomy; the ideal candidate should be able to work independently to build sales offers, take offers to markets and clients, solution for questions related to below, and run deal cycles independently. Drive is needed to help build the HR Process \& Experience Consulting business from its current strong foundations to a potential billion\-scale business.


Core Responsibilities Include:


Work independently to pitch and win clients and manage end to end delivery for:


* HR Transformation Strategy and plan
* Employee Experience Framework
* Hr process design and HR operating Model design
* HR technology implementation management
* HR technology vendor selection and business case design
* HR AI projects

Bring expertise in selling HR consulting services to Indian and global clients through capability showcase, client reachouts, developing and maintaining a sales pipeline.


Manage operations for a team of HR consultants operating in a GDC environment. Success metrics include: utilization management, new sales, account renewals, headcount growth.


**Primary Skills**
------------------


They will have 13\+ years of experience in HR Consulting, HR transformation \& Effectiveness, Employee Experience, Digital HR, Human Capital Strategy Design with a strong project track record and demonstrated P\&L contribution to sales.


Preferred Qualification is MBA/Master’s from Leading University (India / Abroad) in field of Human Resources Management/ Strategy Management


This person is motivated to deliver high\-quality work to drive customer satisfaction. They use their intellect, insight, and ability to build creative solutions with clients and colleagues while embracing a collaborative mindset.


Key qualifications include:


* Significant HR consulting sales experience in India markets OR experience in leading HR process / technology sales in international clients
* Prior experience in managing a full sales and delivery cycle for clients
* Significant prior experience in HR Advisory and HR strategy, process and technology consulting to propose improvements to Hire\-to\-retire HR process.
* Proven previous experience in interacting with Senior members of client organizations, CTOs, COOs, with internal Partners etc.
* Industry experience – anyone or combination of Government, Healthcare, retail, telecom, oil and gas, BSFI, airlines, manufacturing, food and beverages etc.
* Extensive experience in End\-to\-End HR Project and program Management
* Experience in selling and delivering projects to improve Employee Experience in major and complex HR Transformation projects across HRMSs platforms like SuccessFactors, Workday, or equivalent systems
* Experience with at least 3 of the following: payroll, benefits, compensation, time \& attendance, performance management, employee data management, succession planning, learning and development, recruitment, and workforce planning. Experience in working with global teams
* Strong team working skills across matrixes \- client, supplier, and geographically dispersed virtual teams
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills (including negotiation)
* Strong and proven networking skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills – must be able to communicate fluently in English both verbally and in writing
* Experience with working across complex multi\-geography delivery ecosystem is an added bonus

Team management


* Ability to influence and draw consensus
* Proactive and result oriented
* Should be able to work with minimal direction or supervision
* Open and flexible for any given work environment
* Ready to travel on short notice

title: Junior Business Analyst
description:
**SURYA AT A GLANCE**
 Surya creates software products and provides implementation services for Financial Control \& Risk Management (Balance sheet management, Regulatory \& Compliance \& Other Risk areas) of banks and financial services industry. We provide web based, shared facility treasury management products for corporates. Founded in 1999, Surya’s client base is spread across four continents.
   

  

 We help more than 75 banks, hedge funds and corporations around the world make better business decisions by mitigating risk, enhancing profitability and complying with regulatory requirements. We are headquartered in Bangalore, India. We also have offices in USA and France.
   

  

 Surya is an equal opportunity employer
   

  

*Designation: Junior Business Analyst Qualification: Bcom*
**Roles And Responsibilities**
 As a business analyst, you are required to
   

  

* Study, understand and document customer business process and requirements from Financial Control and risk management domain.
* Prepare the gap analysis statement between Surya product and client requirements.
* Study various country specific central bank regulations on risk managements and guide the technical team during the requirement gathering stage as well as actual implementation of the software application.
* Be part of the implementation team during requirement gathering, acceptance test both internal/external customers as well as support during the post implementation phase.
* Write SOPs, checklists for frequent queries / issues, User manuals etc.


**Essential Skills**
* Good communication skills, strong listening skills with a flexible and positive approach to work
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team
* Candidate must be willing to accept responsibility and deliver to the expectations
* Willingness to travel to client site for Implementation / Discussion etc.

title: Robotics, AI & IoT Trainee
description:
EduboticsGlobal is a robotics, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Internet of Things (IoT) company focused on developing innovative technology solutions and building practical skills in emerging technologies.

We are looking for enthusiastic and motivated **freshers** to join our team as **Robotics, AI \& IoT Trainees**. This is an excellent opportunity for candidates who are passionate about technology and want to build a career in robotics, AI, automation, and IoT.

Job Responsibilities

* Assist with robotics, AI, automation, and IoT projects.
* Work with sensors, microcontrollers, embedded systems, and electronic components.
* Support the development and testing of robotics and IoT prototypes.
* Learn and work with programming languages and development tools used in our projects.
* Assist with AI/ML model development and implementation where required.
* Perform testing, troubleshooting, debugging, and basic documentation.
* Work with senior engineers and project teams to complete assigned tasks.
* Research new technologies and contribute ideas for improving projects.
* Follow company development, testing, and safety procedures.

Requirements

* Fresh graduates or candidates with **0–1 year of experience**.
* Degree, diploma, or relevant educational background in:
* Robotics
* Electronics / ECE
* Electrical Engineering
* Computer Science / IT
* Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning
* Mechatronics
* IoT or related fields
* Basic knowledge of programming is an advantage.
* Interest in robotics, AI, IoT, embedded systems, or automation.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Willingness to learn new technologies.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a team.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of any of the following will be an advantage:

* Arduino / ESP32 / Raspberry Pi
* Python / C / C\+\+
* Sensors and actuators
* Embedded systems
* IoT communication and protocols
* Robotics and automation
* AI / Machine Learning
* Computer Vision
* Git / GitHub
* Basic electronics and circuit concepts

**Freshers with strong interest and a willingness to learn are encouraged to apply even if they do not have experience with all of the above technologies.**

What We Offer

* Practical hands\-on experience in Robotics, AI \& IoT.
* Opportunity to work on real\-world technology projects.
* Mentorship and technical guidance.
* Exposure to emerging technologies.
* Career growth opportunities based on performance.
* Opportunity to develop industry\-relevant technical skills.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Work from home

title: Business Development Executive (BDE)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a motivated and result\-oriented **Business Development Executive (BDE)** to help expand our customer base and strengthen business relationships in the bioculture manufacturing industry.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, generating leads, developing customer relationships, and supporting sales growth across relevant markets. The role requires strong communication skills, a willingness to learn technical products, and the ability to understand customer requirements and recommend suitable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and develop new business opportunities through market research, networking, referrals, online platforms, and outbound communication.
* Generate and qualify leads from potential customers, distributors, dealers, institutions, and industry partners.
* Contact prospective clients through calls, emails, LinkedIn, meetings, and other business channels.
* Understand customer requirements and communicate relevant product information effectively.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing and potential customers.
* Conduct product presentations and coordinate with technical teams when detailed product information is required.
* Prepare and share quotations, proposals, product information, and other sales\-related documents.
* Follow up consistently with leads and prospects to move opportunities through the sales pipeline.
* Coordinate with internal teams including sales, marketing, production, logistics, and technical teams to ensure smooth execution of customer requirements.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, customer interactions, follow\-ups, quotations, and sales opportunities.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer needs, and emerging business opportunities.
* Explore opportunities for **distributor, dealer, institutional, and B2B partnerships**.
* Support participation in exhibitions, conferences, trade shows, and industry events.
* Meet assigned business development and sales targets.
* Prepare regular reports on lead generation, sales activities, pipeline status, and business performance.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in **Biotechnology, Microbiology, Life Sciences, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field**.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Good understanding of basic sales and business development concepts.
* Ability to communicate with customers professionally through phone, email, and in\-person meetings.
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-management skills.
* Willingness to learn about **bioculture products, applications, and technical specifications**.
* Good problem\-solving and analytical abilities.
* Comfortable working with sales targets and performance\-based goals.
* Basic knowledge of MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and CRM tools is an advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication skills and a genuine interest in sales and biotechnology are welcome to apply.

Preferred Skills

* Experience in **B2B sales, biotechnology, microbiology, life sciences, or manufacturing**.
* Existing industry contacts or experience with distributors/dealers is an advantage.
* Knowledge of LinkedIn and other platforms for B2B lead generation.
* Strong negotiation and presentation skills.
* Ability to understand technical information and explain it clearly to customers.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings, exhibitions, conferences, and business development activities when required.

title: Nurse
description:
PARUDUR MEDICAL CENTRE (PMC)

JOB DESCRIPTION – ANM NURSE

Position

ANM Nurse – Auxiliary Nurse Midwife

Department

Nursing / Clinical Services

Reports To

Medical Officer / Senior Nurse / Nursing In\-charge

Job Summary

The ANM Nurse is responsible for providing safe, compassionate and efficient basic nursing care to patients under the direction of doctors and senior nursing staff. The nurse will assist in OPD and clinical procedures, monitor patients, administer medications as prescribed, maintain accurate records, follow infection\-control practices and support the smooth functioning of PMC clinical services.

Key Responsibilities

1\. Patient Care

Receive and attend to patients professionally and courteously.

Assess and record basic patient information and vital signs.

Monitor temperature, pulse, blood pressure, respiratory rate, SpO₂ and blood glucose when required.

Provide basic nursing care and assist patients with their immediate needs.

Observe patients for changes in condition and promptly inform the doctor/senior nurse.

2\. Medication \& Injections

Administer prescribed oral and injectable medications within the scope of training and applicable regulations.

Perform injections and other nursing procedures as instructed.

Check medication name, dose, route, timing and patient identification before administration.

Maintain proper medication records.

3\. Assistance to Doctors

Assist doctors during patient examinations and clinical procedures.

Prepare instruments, equipment and supplies before procedures.

Assist with dressing, wound care, nebulization, ECG, blood glucose testing and other services as directed and within competency.

Ensure the treatment/procedure area is properly prepared after each patient.

4\. Emergency Support

Provide immediate basic nursing assistance during emergencies.

Recognize and report deterioration in a patient's condition promptly.

Assist the doctor and senior nursing staff during emergency procedures.

Ensure emergency equipment and essential supplies are readily available.

5\. Maternal \& Child Care

Provide appropriate support for antenatal and postnatal patients within the scope of ANM practice.

Assist with maternal and child health services.

Provide basic health education regarding hygiene, nutrition, medication compliance and preventive care.

6\. Infection Control \& Safety

Strictly follow PMC infection\-control and hygiene protocols.

Maintain hand hygiene and appropriate use of PPE.

Ensure proper cleaning, disinfection and sterilization of reusable instruments as applicable.

Dispose of biomedical waste according to established procedures.

Maintain a clean, safe and organized clinical environment.

7\. Documentation

Maintain accurate nursing notes and patient records.

Record vital signs, medications, procedures and other relevant clinical information.

Maintain registers and documentation as required by PMC.

Protect patient confidentiality at all times.

8\. Equipment \& Supplies

Maintain nursing equipment and ensure it is ready for use.

Check availability of essential medicines, consumables and clinical supplies.

Report damaged, missing or expired items to the Nursing In\-charge.

9\. Patient Communication

Treat patients and relatives with dignity, courtesy and empathy.

Explain basic procedures and instructions clearly.

Maintain professional communication with doctors, nurses and other staff.

Handle patient concerns appropriately and escalate complaints when necessary.

10\. General Responsibilities

Follow PMC policies, procedures and professional standards.

Maintain punctuality, discipline and professional appearance.

Attend assigned shifts and duties as scheduled.

Participate in staff meetings, training and quality\-improvement activities.

Perform other nursing\-related duties assigned by the Medical Officer or Nursing In\-charge within the scope of practice.

Qualification

ANM (Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery) qualification from a recognized institution.

Valid nursing registration as applicable.

Relevant clinical experience preferred; freshers may be considered based on competency.

Required Skills

Good basic nursing and clinical skills

Ability to monitor and record vital signs accurately

Safe medication and injection practices

Good communication and interpersonal skills

Patient\-friendly attitude

Knowledge of infection\-control procedures

Ability to work as part of a healthcare team

Willingness to work in assigned shifts

Professional Standards

The ANM Nurse is expected to maintain:

Patient safety

Confidentiality

Professional ethics

Infection\-control standards

Accurate documentation

Respectful patient care

Punctuality and discipline

Performance Indicators

Performance may be assessed based on:

Quality and safety of patient care

Accuracy of documentation

Compliance with infection\-control procedures

Punctuality and attendance

Teamwork and communication

Patient service and satisfaction

Proper handling of medicines, equipment and supplies

Note: All clinical duties must be performed within the nurse's qualification, training, scope of practice, applicable regulations and PMC protocols.

Pay: ₹8,063\.97 \- ₹13,497\.03 per month

Work Location: In person

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**  

**Blue Dart Express Limited**, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among **India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an **Employer of Choice** is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, **Blue Dart is where you belong**. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


**Position Overview:**  


The **Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations** is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.

**Job Purpose:**  


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities:**  

**Pickup \& Delivery Operations*** Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.

**Customer Service Excellence*** Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.

**COD \& Documentation Management*** Collect Cash on Delivery (COD) payments wherever applicable.
* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.

**Operational Compliance*** Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.

**Safety \& Security*** Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.

**Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility*** Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.

title: Sales Executive – Real Estate | Delcon Homes Pvt. Ltd.
description:
**Job Type:** Commission\-Based / Performance\-Based

**Industry:** Real Estate \& Township Development

**Experience:** Freshers \& Experienced Candidates

**Location:** Patna One Plaza, 7th Floor, Dak Bunglow

**Earning Potential:** Uncapped

**About Delcon Homes Pvt. Ltd.**

Delcon Homes Pvt. Ltd. develops planned townships and offers residential plots to customers looking to build their homes or invest in real estate.

We are expanding our sales network and looking for ambitious, action\-oriented Sales Executives who want to build a high\-income career in real estate.

This is not a traditional 9\-to\-5 salaried role. It is an uncapped, performance\-based opportunity where your income grows with the sales you generate.

**What You Will Do**

As a Sales Executive, your primary responsibility will be to find potential customers, understand their requirements, show them the right property and help them complete their purchase.

Your work will include:

* Generating potential customer leads
* Contacting and speaking with prospects
* Understanding their budget, requirements and investment goals
* Following up consistently with interested customers
* Meeting prospects and building relationships
* Conducting property/site visits
* Explaining project details, location, pricing and investment potential
* Handling customer questions and objections
* Negotiating and assisting in closing deals
* Building your own customer and referral network
* Maintaining regular follow\-up with prospects until closure

**What We Provide**

You don't need to figure out sales on your own. We will train you.

Delcon Homes will provide complete practical training on:

1\. How to Generate Leads

We'll teach you different ways to find potential property buyers and create a consistent pipeline of prospects.

2\. How to Approach Customers

You'll learn how to contact prospects, start conversations, build interest and turn strangers into potential customers.

3\. How to Understand Customer Needs

You'll learn how to identify a customer's budget, purpose, urgency and requirements.

4\. How to Handle Customers

We'll train you on communication, presentations, follow\-ups and relationship building.

5\. How to Handle Objections

You'll learn how to respond when customers say things like:

"Price zyada hai."

"Soch ke batayenge."

"Family se discuss karna hai."

"Abhi investment nahi karna."

"Dusri property bhi dekh rahe hain."

6\. How to Conduct Site Visits

You'll learn how to present the project professionally and help customers make informed decisions.

7\. How to Close Sales

We'll teach you practical sales processes and closing techniques to move qualified prospects toward a purchase.

Our job is to teach you the system. Your job is to execute it.

If you are willing to learn, take action, speak to customers and follow the process consistently, you have the opportunity to build a high\-income career in real estate.

**What You Get**

* Complete sales \& real\-estate training
* Practical lead\-generation training
* Customer acquisition guidance
* Sales scripts and processes
* Site\-visit training
* Objection\-handling training
* Closing guidance
* Ongoing support from the team
* Performance\-based commissions
* Unlimited earning potential
* Opportunity to build your own customer network
* Flexible working model
* Opportunity to grow with a growing real\-estate business

**Who Should Apply?**

This opportunity is suitable for:

Freshers who are willing to learn and work hard

Experienced sales professionals

Real estate salespeople

Insurance agents

Banking/financial sales professionals

Automobile sales professionals

Entrepreneurs

Freelancers

Students/graduates looking to build sales skills

Anyone confident in communication and willing to work on performance

You don't need prior real\-estate experience.

We can teach you real estate and sales.

What we cannot teach is hunger, consistency and willingness to take action.

**Who Will Succeed Here?**

You are a strong fit if you:

Are comfortable talking to new people

Can communicate confidently

Are willing to make calls and meet customers

Don't give up after rejection

Can follow up consistently

Want your income to depend on your performance

Are hungry to learn sales

Want to build something bigger than a fixed monthly salary

**Compensation**

No Fixed Salary

This is a commission\-based, performance\-driven opportunity.

Your earning potential is uncapped and directly linked to your sales performance.

The more qualified customers you generate, follow up with and successfully convert, the more you can earn.

There is no artificial ceiling on your income.

**Important:** This is not a fixed\-salary employment position. Candidates should apply specifically because they are comfortable with a performance\-based earning model.

**The Opportunity**

Most jobs tell you:

"Work for us and we'll pay you a fixed salary."

We are offering something different:

"We'll teach you how to sell. We'll give you the training and support. You execute the process and earn according to your results."

If you are serious about learning sales, customer acquisition and real estate, this can become much more than a job.

It can become a high\-income sales career.

**Apply Now**

If you're ambitious, willing to learn and ready to take action, we'd like to hear from you.

Company: Delcon Homes Pvt. Ltd.

Role: Sales Executive – Real Estate

Compensation: Commission\-Based \| Uncapped Earning Potential

Apply only if you are comfortable with a performance\-based, non\-fixed\-salary model.

Pay: ₹50,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Patna, Bihar (Patna)

Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time\-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000\+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long\-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast\-paced logistics environment and ever\-evolving supply\-chains. It wholly\-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004\.


Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India\-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.


We are proud to be consistently ranked among India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an Employer of Choice is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.


If you are looking to join a purpose\-led, people\-first, company that shapes India’s supply\-chains with integrity and safety, Blue Dart is where you belong. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross\-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.


Position Overview:


The Territory Service Representative (TSR) – Operations is responsible for the timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within an assigned territory while delivering a superior customer experience and representing the Blue Dart brand with professionalism.


Operating as the face of Blue Dart on the ground, the role ensures safe handling of shipments, timely collections and deliveries, accurate shipment scanning, COD collections, proof of delivery (POD) compliance and adherence to operational procedures. The TSR works closely with the Shift In\-charge and branch operations team to ensure service commitments are consistently achieved while maintaining the highest standards of safety, customer service and operational discipline.


Job Purpose:


To execute timely pickup and delivery of shipments, ensure accurate shipment handling, customer interactions and COD collections while adhering to Blue Dart's operational standards, safety requirements and service commitments.


Key Roles \& Responsibilities:


Pickup \& Delivery Operations

* Perform timely pickup and delivery of customer shipments within the assigned route or territory.
* Ensure all shipments are delivered within committed service timelines.
* Verify shipment details before pickup and delivery.
* Handle shipments carefully to prevent damage or loss.
* Maintain delivery productivity and route efficiency.


Customer Service Excellence

* Serve as the face of Blue Dart during every customer interaction.
* Maintain courteous, professional and customer\-centric behaviour at all times.
* Resolve basic customer queries during pickups and deliveries.
* Escalate customer concerns or operational exceptions promptly.
* Maintain high standards of grooming, behaviour and professionalism.


COD \& Documentation Management

* Ensure accurate cash handling and timely remittance as per company procedures.
* Obtain Proof of Delivery (POD), customer acknowledgements and required shipment documentation.
* Ensure documentation accuracy and compliance with operational procedures.
* Report discrepancies immediately.


Operational Compliance

* Scan shipments accurately using handheld devices or approved digital platforms.
* Ensure shipment status updates are completed in real time.
* Follow all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) during pickup and delivery activities.
* Adhere to company policies relating to shipment handling, documentation and customer interaction.
* Support operational requirements during peak business periods.


Safety \& Security

* Follow all road safety guidelines while operating company or personal vehicles.
* Ensure safe handling and security of customer shipments throughout transit.
* Wear the prescribed company uniform and personal protective equipment wherever applicable.
* Report accidents, incidents or unsafe conditions immediately.
* Protect company assets and customer property.


Vehicle \& Asset Responsibility

* Maintain the assigned vehicle or personal two\-wheeler in roadworthy condition.
* Ensure all statutory vehicle documents remain valid.
* Maintain cleanliness and basic upkeep of the vehicle.
* Report maintenance requirements promptly.


Workplace Discipline \& Brand Representation

* Maintain high standards of personal grooming, hygiene and professional appearance.
* Wear the prescribed Blue Dart uniform and identity card while on duty.
* Demonstrate discipline, punctuality and professionalism at all times.
* Follow workplace rules, operational discipline and company policies.
* Represent the Blue Dart brand positively through behaviour, teamwork and commitment to service excellence.


Team Collaboration

* Work closely with Shift In\-charges and branch operations teams.
* Support colleagues during operational contingencies.
* Participate in operational briefings and safety meetings.
* Contribute towards achieving branch productivity and service goals.


Qualifications \& Experience:


Education:

* Minimum 10th Standard Pass.
* Higher educational qualifications will be an added advantage.


Experience:

* Fresher or up to 2 years of relevant experience in courier, logistics, distribution, retail delivery or field operations.
* Experience in pickup and delivery operations will be an added advantage.


Eligibility Requirements:

* Valid Two\-Wheeler or Four\-Wheeler Driving Licence.
* Must own a two\-wheeler where deployment requires the employee to use a personal vehicle, in accordance with Company policy.
* Physically fit to perform field operations.
* Willingness to work across shifts, weekends and holidays based on business requirements.

**Position:** Sales Executive

About the Role

Edvirexa Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a motivated and target\-oriented **Sales Executive** who will be responsible for generating leads, approaching prospective customers, conducting field visits, explaining company products/services, building customer relationships, and converting prospects into successful customers.

The candidate should be confident, energetic, good at communication, comfortable with field sales, and capable of working toward assigned sales targets.

Probation Period \& Compensation

The selected candidate will initially be placed under a **3 to 6 months probation period on an incentive\-based structure**.

During the probation period, performance will be evaluated based on:

* Lead generation
* Customer acquisition
* Field visits and meetings
* Sales conversions
* Revenue generation
* Achievement of assigned targets
* Follow\-up and customer handling
* Communication and negotiation skills
* Attendance, discipline, and consistency
* Overall contribution to the organization

The probation period may be **extended by the company** if the candidate's performance does not meet the required standards or additional evaluation time is required.

In case of consistently unsatisfactory performance, failure to meet assigned responsibilities or targets, misconduct, or other valid organizational reasons, the company may discontinue the engagement during or after the probation period, subject to applicable company policies and law.

After successful completion of the probation period, the company may offer a **permanent employment position**, along with the applicable salary and incentive structure, based on the candidate's performance and organizational requirements.

Key Roles \& Responsibilities1\. Field Sales

* Visit potential customers, businesses, institutions, and other assigned locations.
* Generate leads through direct field visits and networking.
* Meet prospective customers and understand their requirements.
* Present and explain the company's products and services.
* Conduct face\-to\-face sales presentations and demonstrations where required.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective and existing customers.
* Identify new business opportunities within assigned areas.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups after meetings and demonstrations.
* Convert field\-generated leads into successful sales.
* Maintain records of field visits, meetings, leads, and conversions.

2\. Lead Generation \& Sales

* Generate leads through field visits, cold calling, social media, references, campaigns, and other channels.
* Contact prospective customers through phone, WhatsApp, email, and other communication channels.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable products/services.
* Handle customer objections and provide appropriate solutions.
* Negotiate with customers within the company's approved guidelines.
* Follow up consistently with prospective customers.
* Achieve assigned daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.

3\. Customer Relationship Management

* Maintain professional relationships with customers.
* Provide accurate information regarding products, services, pricing, and packages.
* Ensure a positive customer experience throughout the sales process.
* Handle customer queries and coordinate with relevant departments for resolution.
* Collect customer feedback and communicate important information to management.
* Assist with customer onboarding and post\-sales coordination when required.

4\. Reporting \& Coordination

* Maintain accurate records of leads, calls, meetings, field visits, follow\-ups, and sales.
* Update CRM/software or sales trackers regularly.
* Submit daily and weekly sales reports.
* Coordinate with the Sales Manager, Team Leader, Marketing Team, Operations Team, and other departments.
* Participate in sales meetings, training sessions, and performance reviews.
* Follow company sales processes, policies, and reporting procedures.

Required Skills

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Strong convincing and negotiation abilities.
* Confidence in face\-to\-face customer interaction.
* Willingness to travel for field sales.
* Target\-oriented and result\-driven approach.
* Strong follow\-up skills.
* Good customer relationship management skills.
* Ability to handle sales objections professionally.
* Basic knowledge of MS Office, Google Workspace, CRM, or sales\-tracking tools.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team.
* Positive attitude and willingness to learn.

Educational Qualification

* Bachelor's degree in any discipline preferred.
* Freshers are welcome to apply.
* Candidates with previous experience in **Sales, Field Sales, Business Development, EdTech, BFSI, Telecalling, or Customer Relationship Management** will be preferred.

Performance \& KPI

Performance will primarily be measured through:

* Number of leads generated
* Number of field visits
* Customer meetings
* Qualified leads
* Follow\-up consistency
* Conversion rate
* Number of successful sales
* Revenue generated
* Achievement of assigned targets
* Customer satisfaction
* Reporting and documentation
* Attendance and discipline

Career Growth

Based on performance and organizational requirements, the career progression may include:

**Sales Executive → Senior Sales Executive → Team Leader → Sales Manager → Senior Sales Manager / Business Development Manager**

Important Employment Note

The **3–6 month probation period will be incentive\-based**. Successful completion of probation does not automatically guarantee a specific salary, designation, or permanent employment; the final employment terms will be determined based on performance, business requirements, and applicable company policies.

The employee will be expected to comply with company policies, sales targets, reporting requirements, professional conduct standards, and field\-sales responsibilities throughout the engagement.

title: Quality Control Microbiologist & Production of Biofertilizer
description:
Position: Microbiologist \- Biofertilizer Production

Department: Production \& Quality Control \- Biofertilizer Unit

Location: Lucknow / Sidhauli Manufacturing Unit

Employment Type: Full\-time

Reports To: Production Manager / Plant Head

1\. Role Summary

We are looking for a skilled Microbiologist to manage and scale up the production of biofertilizers. The candidate will be responsible for mother culture maintenance, mass multiplication, quality control, and ensuring all products comply with Fertilizer Control Order \[FCO] standards.

2\. Key Responsibilities

A. Production \& Culture Maintenance

* Maintenance, preservation and regular sub\-culturing of mother cultures: Rhizobium, Azotobacter, Azospirillum, PSB \[Phosphate Solubilizing Bacteria], KSB/KMB, Zinc Solubilizing Bacteria, Trichoderma, Mycorrhiza \[VAM].
* Preparation of media, inoculum development, and fermenter, boiler, Colar and Chilar operations \[1L to 250L].
* Supervise carrier\-based and liquid biofertilizer production.
* Maintain batch production records, culture history, and production logbooks.

B. Quality Control \& Quality Assurance

* Microbial count by serial dilution and plate count method as per FCO / BIS specifications.
* Check for contamination, pH, CFU count \[should be \> 1x108 or 1x109 CFU/ml as per product].
* Perform Gram staining, biochemical tests, and viability tests.
* Ensure 100% compliance with FCO norms, FSSAI and organic certification like NPOP, Jaivik Bharat.

C. R\&D and Process Improvement

* Isolation of efficient local strains from soil and field trials.
* Work on improving shelf\-life of liquid biofertilizers \- up to 12\-18 months.
* Develop new consortia products like NPK consortia, biofertilizer \+ biopesticide combo.

D. Documentation \& Compliance

* Preparation of SOPs, COA \[Certificate of Analysis], MSDS, and production reports.
* Handle audits for fertilizer license, organic certification, and lab accreditation.
* Training of lab assistants and production staff on aseptic techniques and hygiene.

3\. Required Qualification \& Experience

* Education: M.Sc. in Microbiology / Agricultural Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Sciences. B.Sc. with strong experience can also be considered.
* Experience: 2\-5 years in biofertilizer / bio\-inoculant / biopesticide industry. Freshers with internship in a biofertilizer lab can be considered for Junior Microbiologist.
* Must have hands\-on experience with Laminar Air Flow, Autoclave, BOD Incubator, Shaker Incubator, Fermenter, Microscope, pH meter.

4\. Skills Required

* Strong knowledge of aseptic techniques and microbial handling
* Knowledge of FCO specifications for biofertilizers
* Lab management and inventory control of media, chemicals, cultures
* Data recording, report writing and good communication
* Problem\-solving attitude and ability to work on the production floor

5\. Salary \& Benefits

* Salary Range in India: Rs. 25,000 \- Rs. 40,000 per month \[Based on experience \- Junior to Senior level]

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹35,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

description:
Job Description – Full Stack Developer**The Growing Graph**

**Position:** Full Stack Developer  
**Department:** Web Development  
**Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Work Mode:** On\-Site  
**Working Days:** Monday to Saturday  
**Working Hours:** 10:30 AM – 7:30 PM  
**Location:** Sector 81, Faridabad

About The Growing Graph

The Growing Graph is a performance\-driven digital marketing and business growth company working with businesses across different industries. We build and manage websites, digital marketing systems, branding, and online growth solutions for our clients.

We are looking for a **hands\-on Full Stack Developer** who can take ownership of website development, WordPress implementation, deployment, maintenance, and technical troubleshooting.

This is an execution\-focused role. We need someone who can **build, customize, deploy, troubleshoot, maintain, and take websites live on our server**.

Key Responsibility

The primary responsibility of this role will be to **develop, deploy, and manage client websites on The Growing Graph's server infrastructure**.

A major part of the role will involve **WordPress website development and deployment**, along with working on custom websites and other web technologies.

You will work closely with the SEO, design, content, and project management teams to ensure websites are properly developed, configured, optimized, deployed, and maintained.

Roles \& Responsibilities1\. WordPress Development \& Management

WordPress will be an important part of this role.

You will be responsible for:

* Developing and customizing WordPress websites.
* Installing and configuring WordPress.
* Working with WordPress themes and page builders.
* Customizing existing themes and templates.
* Creating and editing website pages.
* Managing WordPress plugins and configurations.
* Installing, configuring, updating, and troubleshooting plugins.
* Managing WordPress databases.
* Fixing common WordPress errors and conflicts.
* Customizing basic HTML, CSS, PHP, and JavaScript where required.
* Implementing forms, integrations, tracking codes, and other website functionality.
* Performing WordPress migrations between servers/hosting environments.
* Taking WordPress websites from staging to live production.
* Maintaining and updating existing client websites.
* Ensuring WordPress websites remain secure, functional, and updated.

**Experience with Elementor, WPBakery, Gutenberg, WooCommerce, or similar WordPress tools will be an advantage.**

2\. Website Deployment

* Deploy websites on the company's server.
* Configure domains, subdomains, DNS, SSL, hosting, and related settings.
* Upload and configure website files and databases.
* Connect websites with the appropriate domains.
* Ensure websites are properly accessible after deployment.
* Troubleshoot deployment\-related errors.
* Manage staging and production environments.
* Take websites from development/staging to live production.

3\. Server Management

* Work with the company's hosting/server environment.
* Manage website directories, databases, permissions, and configurations.
* Monitor basic server performance and website uptime.
* Identify and resolve common server and hosting issues.
* Perform website backups and restoration when required.
* Maintain organized server structures for multiple client websites.
* Follow proper security practices while accessing and managing the server.

4\. Full Stack Development

The candidate should have a working understanding of:

* HTML
* CSS
* JavaScript
* PHP
* MySQL
* APIs and basic integrations
* Git/GitHub
* WordPress
* Basic frontend and backend troubleshooting

Experience with modern frameworks such as **React, Next.js, Node.js, Laravel, or similar technologies** will be an advantage.

5\. Website Maintenance \& Troubleshooting

* Fix website bugs and technical issues.
* Make frontend and backend changes when required.
* Update plugins, themes, libraries, and dependencies.
* Troubleshoot broken pages, forms, integrations, and database issues.
* Resolve WordPress plugin and theme conflicts.
* Maintain website functionality after deployment.
* Assist in improving website speed and technical performance.
* Identify and resolve hosting\-related issues.

6\. Domain, DNS \& SSL Management

The candidate should be comfortable working with:

* Domain pointing
* DNS records
* A Records
* CNAME Records
* Nameservers
* SSL installation and renewal
* Subdomains
* Website redirects
* Basic hosting configurations

7\. Website Migration

The candidate should be capable of handling website migrations, including:

* WordPress\-to\-WordPress migrations.
* Hosting\-to\-hosting migrations.
* Server\-to\-server website transfers.
* Database migration.
* Domain changes.
* SSL configuration after migration.
* Resolving broken links and configuration issues after migration.
* Testing the website after migration.

8\. Client Website Deployment

For every website project, you will be responsible for ensuring that:

* The final website is received from the development/design team.
* The website is properly tested before deployment.
* The domain is correctly connected.
* SSL is configured.
* Forms and important functionality are working.
* Mobile and desktop versions are checked.
* Website errors are resolved before going live.
* Basic technical SEO requirements are implemented.
* The live website is handed over to the concerned internal team.

9\. Coordination With Internal Teams

You will work closely with:

* **SEO Team** – for technical SEO requirements, indexing, redirects, sitemap, robots.txt, website speed, etc.
* **Project Managers** – for deployment timelines and project status.
* **Design Team** – for design implementation and technical feasibility.
* **Content Team** – for content implementation and website updates.
* **Management** – for server, infrastructure, and technical requirements.

Required SkillsEssential Technical Skills

* **Strong working knowledge of WordPress.**
* Ability to independently develop and deploy WordPress websites.
* Experience with WordPress themes and plugins.
* Knowledge of Elementor or other major WordPress page builders.
* Good understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
* Working knowledge of PHP.
* Basic knowledge of MySQL/database management.
* Understanding of hosting and server environments.
* Understanding of domains, DNS, SSL, and website deployment.
* Familiarity with Git/GitHub.
* Ability to troubleshoot website and server issues.

Additional Skills

Knowledge of any of the following will be an advantage:

* Elementor
* WooCommerce
* cPanel
* VPS
* Linux server
* Apache/Nginx
* Cloudflare
* Git/GitHub
* React
* Next.js
* Node.js
* Laravel
* REST APIs

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking only for someone with certificates or theoretical knowledge.

We need a **hands\-on developer** who:

* Can independently build WordPress websites.
* Can deploy websites on our server.
* Understands domains, DNS, hosting, and SSL.
* Can migrate websites from one server to another.
* Can troubleshoot WordPress issues.
* Can fix plugin/theme conflicts.
* Can make basic code\-level changes when required.
* Can troubleshoot frontend and backend issues.
* Is comfortable working with servers.
* Can learn new technologies quickly.
* Takes complete ownership of assigned websites.
* Can work under project deadlines.

Experience

**Required Experience:** 6 Months – 1 Year

Candidates must have practical experience working with **WordPress and website deployment**.

Freshers may be considered only if they have strong practical project experience and can demonstrate their ability to independently develop and deploy websites.

Experience working with multiple client websites, digital agencies, hosting environments, or server deployments will be an advantage.

Performance Expectations

The developer will be expected to:

* Develop and deploy websites within assigned deadlines.
* Maintain high\-quality WordPress implementations.
* Minimize deployment errors and downtime.
* Resolve technical issues quickly.
* Maintain clean and organized server structures.
* Keep websites secure and updated.
* Maintain proper backups where required.
* Communicate technical issues clearly to the project manager.
* Take complete ownership of assigned technical tasks.

Professional Expectations

* Maintain punctuality and discipline.
* Follow internal development and deployment processes.
* Maintain confidentiality of company and client information.
* Never share server credentials or client access details.
* Do not make unauthorized changes to live websites or servers.
* Maintain proper documentation of important technical configurations.
* Communicate proactively when facing blockers.
* Take responsibility for mistakes and work towards quick resolution.
* Maintain professional communication with internal teams.

Growth Opportunity

At The Growing Graph, developers will have the opportunity to work on websites across multiple industries and gain practical exposure to:

* WordPress development
* Full\-stack development
* Server management
* Website deployment
* Hosting infrastructure
* Technical SEO
* Website security
* Performance optimization
* APIs and integrations
* Client project management

As the company grows, strong performers may progress into roles such as:

**Senior Full Stack Developer → Technical Lead → Development Manager → Head of Technology**

Why Join The Growing Graph?

* Work on real\-world client projects.
* Work with multiple businesses and industries.
* Gain practical WordPress and server deployment experience.
* Work across multiple technologies.
* Learn alongside SEO, marketing, design, and business teams.
* Take ownership of complete website projects.
* Build strong practical development and infrastructure skills.
* Grow with a rapidly developing digital business.

How to Apply

Interested candidates can share their:

* Updated Resume/CV
* Portfolio
* GitHub profile (if available)
* Examples of WordPress websites developed by them
* Examples of websites they have deployed or migrated

title: Product & Visual Design Intern
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly detail\-oriented **Product \& Visual Design Intern** who can work across both **UI/UX design and graphic design**.

You will help design real production products, SaaS platforms, dashboards, admin interfaces, marketing assets, presentations, brand materials, and digital communication.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that good design is not only about making something visually attractive. It is about **structure, usability, hierarchy, consistency, communication, and attention to detail**.

You should be comfortable moving between structured product interfaces and creative visual design while maintaining a consistent design language.

What We Expect

* Strong visual and layout discipline
* Excellent attention to spacing, alignment, typography, and hierarchy
* Understanding of UI/UX fundamentals
* Ability to work within established design systems
* Strong graphic design and visual communication skills
* Ability to follow brand guidelines precisely
* Ability to create polished, production\-ready designs
* Willingness to receive feedback and iterate quickly

We are looking for designers who can balance **creativity with structure**.

ResponsibilitiesProduct \& UI/UX Design

* Design dashboards, SaaS interfaces, admin panels, forms, tables, and analytics screens
* Convert wireframes and requirements into high\-fidelity interfaces
* Work with structured design systems such as the **IBM Carbon Design System** or similar systems
* Follow grid systems, spacing scales, typography systems, and predefined design tokens
* Create reusable Figma components and maintain component consistency
* Design responsive layouts for desktop, tablet, and mobile interfaces
* Improve usability and information hierarchy across product experiences

Graphic \& Visual Design

* Create social media graphics and digital campaign assets
* Design presentations, reports, brochures, posters, and communication materials
* Create illustrations and visual compositions using established brand guidelines
* Develop graphics for websites, landing pages, product launches, and marketing campaigns
* Maintain consistency across digital and print visual communication
* Prepare production\-ready design files and assets

Brand Design

* Work within established brand identities
* Maintain consistency in typography, colour, imagery, iconography, and visual language
* Help develop reusable visual templates and brand assets
* Ensure every visual touchpoint feels like part of the same brand ecosystem

Collaboration

* Work closely with frontend developers during product implementation
* Ensure designs are translated accurately into production interfaces
* Collaborate with product, marketing, management, and content teams
* Accept design feedback professionally and iterate quickly
* Maintain organised Figma files and design documentation

Research \& Iteration

* Study enterprise software products and contemporary digital design practices
* Analyse existing interfaces and identify opportunities for improvement
* Explore visual references without blindly copying existing designs
* Conduct basic usability validation and design reviews
* Continuously improve design quality through structured iteration

Skills Required

* Strong proficiency in **Figma**
* Good understanding of UI/UX fundamentals
* Strong graphic design abilities
* Understanding of grid systems and spacing systems
* Good typography and visual hierarchy skills
* Strong alignment and composition discipline
* Understanding of colour, layout, branding, and visual communication
* Ability to create reusable components and structured Figma libraries
* Ability to work within strict design guidelines
* Strong attention to pixel\-level details

Knowledge of tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects, Blender, or similar creative tools is an advantage but not mandatory.

Portfolio Expectations

Your portfolio should ideally demonstrate a combination of:

* Product or dashboard UI
* Mobile or web interface design
* Graphic design
* Brand or visual communication work
* Typography and layout
* Structured design\-system usage

We value **quality, thinking, and attention to detail** more than the number of projects in your portfolio.

Qualifications

No specific degree is required.

Students, freshers, and self\-taught designers are welcome to apply.

Your portfolio, design thinking, visual discipline, and ability to execute matter more than formal qualifications.

**Additional preference will be given to candidates who have completed IBM Design, Enterprise Design Thinking, UI/UX, Carbon Design System, or other relevant IBM design courses and certifications.**

Relevant certifications from recognised design platforms are also considered an advantage when supported by strong practical work.

What You Will Learn

* Enterprise\-level UI/UX design
* Structured design\-system workflows
* Production\-ready SaaS product design
* Graphic and visual communication
* Brand\-system implementation
* Collaboration between designers and frontend engineers
* Building reusable components and scalable design systems
* Designing for real\-world products rather than conceptual portfolio projects

Internship Details

* Duration: **2 to 6 months**
* Hands\-on work on real products and brands
* Fast\-paced learning environment
* Exposure to both product and visual design
* Performance\-based opportunity for a full\-time role

Who This Role Is Best For

This role is especially suitable for someone who does not want to restrict themselves to only UI screens or only graphic design.

You should enjoy designing a structured enterprise dashboard one day and working on a presentation, campaign graphic, brand asset, or visual communication piece the next.

We are looking for a designer who can think in **systems when structure is required and creatively when communication is required.**

Pay: Up to ₹15,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

 Who we are

 To provide hope and support to parents as primary caregivers of children touched by autism, down syndrome and other developmental disabilities.

 Nayi Disha is a progressive non\-profit that leverages technology and works as a lifelong partner for families affected by Autism and other developmental disabilities. The four LEAD behaviours are: L \- Listen and be authentic, E \- Energise and inspire, A \- Align across the enterprise, D \- Develop others..

**Job Description**
 Role: Data Scientist
   

  

 Reporting to: Senior Data Science Manager

**Background**
 Who we are
   

  

 We are Data Tech, a program that comprises a number of agile, cross\-functional teams between London, Sofia, and Bangalore. We grow data platforms, build front\-end data products, and create predictive models and Gen AI products for News UK. Our users include the newsroom editors, marketing, advertising, and product teams associated with our world\-leading digital and print publications. We believe that technology will always be a tool driven by human intent.

 Who we are looking for
   

  

 We are looking for a Data Scientist to join the home of Data Science within News UK. You will work hands\-on across a portfolio of AI and ML products, from LLM\-powered editorial tools to personalisation and predictive models that shape what millions of readers see, read, and stay subscribed to.
   

  

 This is a build\-focused role. You will spend most of your time in code: training models, designing and running evaluations, building RAG and LLM features, and shipping work that holds up in production. You will contribute to architecture and design discussions, and grow into owning larger pieces of work over time.
   

  

 We care as much about how you work as what you build. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly with both technical and non\-technical people, who takes the initiative rather than waiting to be told, and who brings solid engineering practices to everything they ship. If you have a genuine interest
   

  

 in AI, a drive to take sensible risks, and the curiosity to keep learning, this is a great place to do your best work.
   

  

**Our Current Tech Stack**
* Cloud and infrastructure: Google Cloud Platform, Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GCS, Cloud Composer, Cloud Scheduler
* GenAI development: Python, LangChain, LangGraph, Google ADK, Gemini, Claude, Vertex AI RAG Engine, prompt engineering
* Machine learning: scikit\-learn, XGBoost / LightGBM, PyTorch, personalisation and recommender approaches, embedding\-based retrieval, classical statistical modelling

* Explore agentic approaches using Google ADK and similar tooling, and turn promising ideas into working features.
* Keep up with new AI models and methods, and bring ideas to the team proactively.
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams, and communicate your work clearly to stakeholders across the newsroom, marketing, and product.

**Essential**

* Strong software engineering foundations: clean, well\-structured Python, testing, version control with Git, code review, and comfort taking work from notebook to production.
* Hands\-on MLOps experience: building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, containerising and deploying models on Cloud Run, and setting up model monitoring and drift detection.
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) and building reproducible, automated pipelines.
* Confident with GCP, ideally Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GCS, and Cloud Composer.
* Strong SQL for querying and shaping large datasets.
* Hands\-on experience across the ML lifecycle, including feature engineering, model selection, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring, for classification, regression, and time\-series problems.

* Strong communication skills, able to explain technical work clearly to non\-technical audiences.

title: QA Engineer
description:
**Position Overview**
 We are seeking a skilled and proactive QA SDET – 2 to join our distribution team. This isn't your typical "just run the test cases" role. We need someone who can deeply understand our AI ecosystem, take ownership of quality across the product, and drive testing excellence through automation and first\-principles thinking. You'll work autonomously in a remote environment, requiring strong self\-direction, excellent communication, and genuine curiosity about both the product and the testing craft.
   

  

**You will be responsible for**
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test suites with a goal of automating 80% of integration tests, ensuring comprehensive coverage and reliability.
* Go beyond surface\-level testing by truly grasping how our AI product works, the user journey, edge cases, and potential failure modes.
* Identify quality risks early, surface issues before they reach production, and continuously improve our testing processes without waiting to be told.
* Build reusable test frameworks and components using modern testing tools and best practices.
* Break down complex testing challenges from the ground up, questioning assumptions and designing effective test strategies.
* Produce clear video demonstrations of issues, test scenarios, and product features, along with well\-structured documentation for test cases, automation frameworks, and quality processes.
* Own the delivery of an entire software development test suites and framework
* Work closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, provide quality insights early in the development cycle, and ensure testability is built into features.
* Articulate quality concerns, test results, and recommendations clearly in a remote environment through written updates, documentation, and team discussions.


**Requirements**
* 2\+ years of experience in QA/SDET roles with a strong focus on test automation and integration testing
* Proficiency in languages like JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and Ruby for writing test automation
* Experience with tools like Playwright, Selenium, Jest, or similar frameworks for frontend and API testing
* Proven ability to design and implement comprehensive test strategies that cover complex user workflows
* Ability to break down problems from fundamentals, question assumptions, and design effective testing approaches rather than following rote processes
* Comfortable creating detailed documentation, test plans, bug reports, and asynchronous updates for a distributed team
* Takes initiative to identify issues, improve processes, and learn new technologies without constant direction
* Passion for understanding how things work, staying current with testing best practices, and diving deep into the AI/ML domain
* Proven ability to work effectively in a distributed team environment with minimal supervision
