title: Frontend Developer
description:
The role ensures that StarZen's digital platforms deliver a consistent, performant, and accessible experience across devices and browsers, translating design systems and product requirements into production\-ready interfaces used by customers, internal teams, and partners.
 



 The Frontend Developer operates as the technical partner to product and design teams, translating UI/UX designs, business requirements, and technical constraints into scalable, maintainable, and well\-tested frontend code using Vue.js, React, and Next.js.
 



  





**Accountability \& Responsibilities of Role:**




**1\. Application Development \& Ownership** 




 • Own the end\-to\-end development of frontend features across:
 



 o Vue.js applications
 



 o React applications
 



 o Next.js applications (SSR/SSG)
 



 • Translate UI/UX designs and wireframes into high\-quality, reusable components
 



 • Ensure consistent behaviour and appearance of interfaces across browsers and devices
 



 • Ensure performance, accessibility, and responsiveness standards are met in every release
 



**2\. API Integration \& Data Handling** 




 • Integrate frontend applications with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL services
 



 • Manage application state using appropriate libraries (Redux, Pinia, Vuex, Zustand, or similar)
 



 • Handle asynchronous data flows, caching, and error states gracefully
 



 • Partner closely with backend developers to define and refine API contracts
 



**3\. Code Quality \& Collaboration** 




 • Write clean, well\-documented, and testable code following team coding standards
 



 • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical design discussions
 



 • Collaborate with designers, product managers, and QA to deliver end\-to\-end features
 



 • Mentor junior developers on frontend best practices where applicable
 



**4\. Performance, Testing \& Reliability** 




 • Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and cross\-browser compatibility
 



 • Write and maintain unit/integration tests to catch regressions early
 



 • Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve UI bugs and performance issues in production
 



 • Monitor frontend performance metrics and proactively address degradations
 



**5\. Continuous Improvement** 




 • Stay current with emerging frontend technologies, tools, and best practices
 



 • Recommend and adopt tooling improvements (build tools, linting, CI/CD) that improve developer velocity
 



 • Contribute to shared component libraries and design system documentation
 



  





**Position Requirements:**




  





 • 3\-6 years of professional experience in frontend web development
 



 • Strong proficiency in Vue.js and its core principles (Composition API, Vuex/Pinia, Vue Router)
 



 • Solid experience with React.js, including Hooks, Context API, and component\-based architecture
 



 • Hands\-on experience with Next.js, including SSR, SSG, and API routes
 



 • Strong command of HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+) / TypeScript
 



 • Experience with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and asynchronous data handling
 



 • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows
 



 • Experience in consumer\-facing digital products or e\-commerce platforms is a strong advantage
 



  





**Key Competencies:**




  





 • Clear improvements in application performance, load times, and responsiveness
 



 • Measurable reduction in UI bugs and production incidents post\-release
 



 • Strong alignment between design intent and shipped user experience
 



 • Consistent code quality demonstrated through review feedback and test coverage
 



 • Effective collaboration with design, backend, and QA teams to ship features on schedule

title: API Developer, Reservoir Management & Forecasting
description:
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
   

  

 Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever\-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
   

  

**About The Position**
 The API Developer is responsible for designing, developing, testing, and maintaining backend services and application programming interfaces (APIs) that support RMF business and engineering applications. The role focuses on building secure, reliable, and maintainable backend solutions using Microsoft Azure, .NET, and Python within homegrown web applications. This position works closely with cross\-functional teams including product owners, front\-end developers, data engineers, and domain specialists to implement well\-defined requirements and deliver scalable solutions. The role operates within established enterprise standards, tooling, and deployment pipelines, applies sound object\-oriented design principles, and contributes to continuous improvement of system performance, reliability, and code quality. The role also leverages Generative AI (GenAI)–enabled engineering practices to improve development efficiency and solution quality.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Software \& Backend API Engineering**
* Design, develop, test, and support backend services and RESTful APIs in a production environment.
* Develop internal APIs using C\#, .NET, and Python, including OpenAPI / Swagger documentation.
* Apply SOLID principles and established design patterns to create loosely coupled, maintainable, and extensible solutions.
* Apply sound API design principles including data validation, error handling, and versioning.
* Write maintainable, readable, and testable code following modern software engineering best practices.
* Implement and maintain unit tests to ensure code quality, reliability, and regression prevention.
* Apply core software engineering concepts such as object\-oriented design, asynchronous processing, threading, source control, and structured debugging.
* Demonstrate working knowledge of Angular and Blazor to support UI integration and troubleshooting (secondary skill).


**Cloud \& Data Engineering**
* Develop and operate applications within an enterprise Microsoft Azure cloud platform.
* Implement solutions using Azure services such as Azure Functions, Azure App Services, and Azure Redis.
* Work with multiple data storage models including Document databases, Azure Storage Accounts, and SQL databases.
* Support application performance, reliability, and scalability through efficient backend and system design.
* Monitor, log, and troubleshoot application behavior in a cloud environment.
* Demonstrate familiarity with containerization concepts.


**Generative AI (GenAI) \& Modern Engineering Practices**
* Use enterprise\-approved Generative AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to assist with code generation, refactoring, documentation, and unit test creation.
* Apply human\-in\-the\-loop judgment to ensure AI\-assisted outputs adhere to Chevron standards for security, reliability, maintainability, and compliance.
* Continuously evaluate and responsibly adopt emerging GenAI capabilities within enterprise guardrails.


**Enterprise Tools \& Standards**
* Work within Chevron\-built tools such as Orion, Azure DevOps Pipelines (formerly Pipeline Framework), ACME, NextPage, and Status.
* Use commonly adopted tools including GHAZDO, DAST, GitHub Copilot (intermediate level), Visual Studio Code, and ServiceNow (SNOW).
* Ensure solutions align with Chevron engineering standards including CDAS and cvxcontrols.


**Differentiating \& Desired Skills**
* Experience with Python frameworks and packages such as FastAPI, Pydantic, Pytest, Pandas, or Polars.
* Basic knowledge of statistics as applied to engineering or analytical workflows.
* Familiarity with common backend and enterprise application design patterns (e.g., repository, factory, strategy).


**Behaviors \& Continuous Improvement**
* Demonstrates Chevron Way and Operational Excellence (OE) behaviors: direct, decisive, accountable, and results\-focused.
* Owns and closes backlog work items and shows initiative in identifying features aligned with RMF product objectives.
* Demonstrates strong problem\-solving capability with appropriate escalation to peers, leads, architects, or Chevron Cloud Support.
* Collaborates effectively with cross\-functional and geographically dispersed teams.
* Demonstrates openness to feedback, continuous learning, and improvement.
* Contributes to a safe, respectful, and inclusive work environment.


**What We Can Offer You**
 Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
   

  

 Have the opportunity to take part in world\-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
   

  

 Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
   

  

 Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well\-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
   

  

 Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
   

  

 Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well\-being, and work\-life balance.
   

  

 Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.
   

  

**How To Apply**
 To be a part of our success, click
 **APPLY** 
 to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time\-limited Visa status for this position.

**Experience:** 
  2–3 Years
 



**Employment Type:** 
  Full\-time
   




 About the Role
 
 Dots\-In is building a new kind of personalised internet powered by our 
 **Large Behavioural Model (LBM)** 
  and 
 **Living Twin** 
 .
 



 We’re looking for a strong 
 **Flutter Developer** 
  who can build beautiful, fast and highly interactive consumer mobile experiences.
 



 This is not a basic CRUD\-app role. We want someone whose portfolio shows strong work in 
 **premium UI, animations, maps, feeds, dynamic cards, social interactions and real\-time experiences.**



 What You’ll Build
 
 You’ll work on core Dots\-In experiences such as:
 


* Living Twin
* Personalised Feed
* Interactive Maps \& Timelines
* AI assistants and chat interfaces
* Social and networking features
* Dynamic cards and widgets
* Goals, health and productivity experiences
* Real\-time and personalised UI


 What We’re Looking For
 * 2–3 years of strong Flutter/Dart experience
* Experience shipping production mobile apps
* Strong understanding of Flutter architecture and widget lifecycle
* Experience with Riverpod / BLoC / Provider
* REST APIs, WebSockets, authentication and caching
* Custom animations, gestures and transitions
* Responsive and pixel\-accurate UI implementation
* Performance optimisation for lists, animations and rendering
* Firebase, push notifications, deep links and analytics

* Mapbox / Google Maps
* Rive / Lottie
* CustomPainter
* AI or LLM\-powered applications
* Social apps
* Health or fitness apps

 You should care about:
 


* UI polish

* Motion
* Performance

**3\. Short Product UI Challenge** 




**4\. Founder / Product Discussion**

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Optical Metrology Division products are used for optical overlay metrology. The portfolio of products includes unique solution packages which are based on hardware and software systems to enhance yield and effectiveness. As a world leader in its field of expertise, the division's products are the most advanced in performance (measurement accuracy of nanometers and below), reliability, ease of use and compatibility with other KLA's products. KLA (Israel) controls over 80% of the world market sales in its field, and its products are used by every major semiconductor manufacturer around the world. KLA Israel is located in the Migdal Haemek Industrial Park.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
 Qualifications/Requirements:
   

  

* Required: BE/BS/BTech degree with 1 or more years of SW experience.
* Required: Strong in programming fundamentals, C\+\+, C\#, MFC and COM
* Required: Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering
* Required: Experience in analysis, design, development and unit testing
* Required: Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
* Required: Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
* Required: Willingness to travel to Israel, US and other customer places on short assignments.
* Preferred: Experience in .Net and C\#/WPF
* Preferred: Knowledge in STL, Boost Library and Windows Internals.
* Optional: Knowledge of KLA specific or general semiconductor domain


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree and 0 years related work experience; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 2 years
   

  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer*
 Be aware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as KLA employees. KLA never asks for any financial compensation to be considered for an interview, to become an employee, or for equipment. Further, KLA does not work with any recruiters or third parties who charge such fees either directly or on behalf of KLA. Please ensure that you have searched KLA’s Careers website for legitimate job postings. KLA follows a recruiting process that involves multiple interviews in person or on video conferencing with our hiring managers. If you are concerned that a communication, an interview, an offer of employment, or that an employee is not legitimate, please send an email to talent.acquisition@kla.com to confirm the person you are communicating with is an employee. We take your privacy very seriously and confidentially handle your information.

title: Embedded Engineer
description:
We are looking for a
 **Senior Embedded Systems Engineer** 
 with a strong background in both
 **embedded firmware development** 
 and
 **hardware integration** 
 . This role requires hands\-on experience with
 **microcontroller\-based system design** 
 ,
 **low\-level driver development** 
 , and
 **hardware debugging** 
 . You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to develop end\-to\-end embedded solutions in a fast\-paced, innovation\-driven environment.
   





**Key Responsibilities:** 
  





**Embedded Software Responsibilities:** 
  




* Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware using
 **Embedded C/C\+\+** 
 for microcontrollers (ARM Cortex, STM32, NXP, etc.).
* Develop and integrate
 **device drivers** 
 ,
 **communication stacks** 
 ,
 **RTOS** 
 \-based and
 **bare\-metal applications** 
 .
* Optimize embedded code for performance, power, and memory footprint.
* Perform unit testing, code reviews, and ensure compliance with coding standards (e.g.,
 **MISRA\-C** 
 ).
* Implement bootloaders, BSPs, and secure firmware update mechanisms.



**Hardware Responsibilities:** 
  




* Collaborate with hardware design engineers to define
 **system architecture** 
 ,
 **component selection** 
 , and
 **interface logic** 
 .
* Bring\-up of new hardware boards including low\-level hardware testing and validation.
* Perform
 **hardware\-software integration** 
 , debugging using tools like
 **oscilloscopes** 
 ,
 **logic analyzers** 
 , and
 **JTAG debuggers** 
 .
* Conduct schematic reviews and work with layout teams to optimize signal integrity, EMI/EMC, and power design.
* Support
 **PCB bring\-up** 
 , prototyping, and hardware testing cycles.
* Document hardware interfaces, configurations, and BOM evaluations.


 Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in
 **Electronics Engineering** 
 ,
 **Electrical Engineering** 
 , or
 **Computer Engineering** 
 .
* 6–10 years of experience in
 **embedded systems design and development** 
 .
* Strong programming skills in
 **C/C\+\+** 
 for microcontroller firmware development.
* Experience with
 **RTOS** 
 (e.g., FreeRTOS, Zephyr) and
 **bare\-metal environments** 
 .
* Proficiency with
 **communication protocols** 
 : I2C, SPI, UART, CAN, USB, Modbus.
* Hands\-on experience with
 **schematic\-level hardware debugging** 
 .
* Familiarity with microcontroller families like
 **STM32** 
 ,
 **NXP Kinetis** 
 ,
 **TI MSP430** 
 ,
 **ESP32** 
 , etc.
* Experience with tools such as
 **Keil** 
 ,
 **IAR** 
 ,
 **Eclipse** 
 ,
 **Altium Designer** 
 ,
 **Oscilloscope** 
 ,
 **Multimeter** 
 ,
 **JTAG/SWD** 
 interfaces.
* Solid understanding of
 **analog/digital circuit design** 
 ,
 **power management** 
 , and
 **PCB fundamentals** 
 .
* Excellent debugging, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and cross\-team collaboration.
* Ability to mentor junior engineers and guide project design decisions.
* Agile and adaptable mindset for rapid prototyping and iteration.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Company Description** 
 Netraon is a customer intelligence and market research company that helps organizations stay closely aligned with evolving customer needs. By transforming feedback, behavior data, and market signals into clear, actionable insights, Netraon enables businesses to respond more effectively to customer expectations. The company supports clients in understanding what customers truly want, tracking how competitors are evolving, and adapting quickly to market changes. In a constantly shifting environment, Netraon focuses on providing clarity that helps businesses not just keep up, but thrive.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Data Analyst role at Netraon is a full\-time, remote position focused on turning complex data into practical insights for internal teams and clients. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include collecting, cleaning, and validating data from multiple sources, performing statistical and analytical evaluations, and building data models to support customer intelligence and market research initiatives. The Data Analyst will create reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings clearly, collaborate with cross\-functional teams to frame business questions, and translate data insights into recommendations for action. This role also involves documenting analytical methodologies, ensuring data quality, and contributing to continuous improvement of analytical processes and tools.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong analytical skills and experience in data analytics to interpret complex datasets and identify trends.
* Proficiency in statistics and statistical analysis methods to support evidence\-based decision\-making.
* Hands\-on experience with data modeling, including designing and maintaining data structures for reporting and analysis.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present data insights clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort working with data tools and languages such as SQL, Python or R, and modern BI/visualization platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker).
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (such as Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science) or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong attention to detail, problem\-solving mindset, and ability to work independently in a remote environment.
* Experience in market research, customer analytics, or related domains is beneficial.

* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Experience analyzing customer behavior and conversion funnels.
* Understanding of marketing attribution and digital analytics.
* Ability to communicate insights clearly to business stakeholders.
* Comfortable working with large datasets from multiple systems.

* Experience with BigQuery.

description:
Operations \& Admin Executive

**GiftAbled Foundation – Uttar Pradesh**

About GiftAbled Foundation

GiftAbled Foundation is a social\-impact organization working towards creating an inclusive society by enabling persons with disabilities through education, healthcare, livelihood, skill development, and community\-based programs.

Position

**Designation:** Operations \& Admin Executive  
**Location:** Uttar Pradesh – Balrampur / Siddharthnagar / Bhinga  
**Department:** Operations \& Administration  
**Employment Type:** Full\-time  
**Reporting To:** HR / Admin Lead

Job Summary

The Operations \& Admin Executive will be responsible for the smooth day\-to\-day administration and operational functioning of GiftAbled Foundation’s centers and programs in Uttar Pradesh. The role involves facility management, procurement, vendor coordination, travel and logistics, inventory, documentation, staff support, and coordination with program teams.

The ideal candidate should be organized, proactive, comfortable working in field locations, and capable of independently handling multiple administrative and operational activities.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Center \& Facility Management**

* Ensure smooth day\-to\-day functioning of the assigned center/office.
* Manage office infrastructure, furniture, equipment, electricity, internet, housekeeping, security, and maintenance.
* Coordinate repairs, servicing, and preventive maintenance.
* Maintain proper records of assets and facilities.
* Ensure cleanliness, safety, accessibility, and basic compliance at the center.

**2\. Procurement \& Vendor Management**

* Collect requirements from program and support teams.
* Obtain quotations and coordinate procurement as per organizational procedures.
* Coordinate with vendors for supplies, services, repairs, and maintenance.
* Maintain vendor records, quotations, purchase documents, invoices, and payment\-related documents.
* Track pending orders and ensure timely delivery of materials.

**3\. Inventory \& Asset Management**

* Maintain records of office supplies, equipment, furniture, and other organizational assets.
* Conduct periodic physical verification of inventory and assets.
* Maintain stock registers and issue/return records.
* Report damaged, missing, or obsolete assets to the reporting manager.
* Ensure proper tagging and documentation of organizational assets.

**4\. Travel \& Logistics**

* Coordinate travel, accommodation, local transportation, and logistics for staff and visitors.
* Support field visits, meetings, training programs, workshops, and organizational events.
* Coordinate guest house/hotel bookings and maintain related records.
* Support vehicle management, including servicing, fuel records, insurance, documentation, and logbooks.

**5\. Administrative Coordination**

* Maintain administrative files, registers, agreements, bills, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with HR, Finance, Program, and other departments for operational requirements.
* Support onboarding arrangements for new employees and interns, including workspace, equipment, ID cards, and other requirements.
* Coordinate routine office communications and follow\-ups.

**6\. Finance \& Documentation Support**

* Collect and verify vendor invoices and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for timely processing of approved bills and payments.
* Maintain records of advances, petty cash, expenses, and administrative purchases as applicable.
* Ensure all administrative expenses are supported by appropriate documentation.

**7\. Events \& Program Support**

* Provide operational support for training programs, community events, workshops, meetings, and awareness activities.
* Arrange venues, seating, equipment, refreshments, transportation, printing, and other logistics.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external service providers to ensure smooth execution.

**8\. Compliance \& Safety**

* Ensure basic administrative and safety procedures are followed at the center.
* Maintain records related to licenses, AMC/service agreements, insurance, fire safety, equipment servicing, and other operational requirements.
* Escalate safety, security, infrastructure, or compliance issues promptly.

**9\. Field \& Center Coordination**

* Coordinate regularly with UP centers and field teams regarding operational requirements.
* Conduct periodic visits to centers to assess administrative and facility requirements.
* Follow up on pending operational issues and ensure timely closure.
* Support the State/Program Lead in implementing operational systems and processes.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate degree in **Business Administration, Management, Operations, Commerce, or a related field**.
* **2–4 years of experience** in administration, operations, facility management, procurement, logistics, or a similar role.
* Experience working with NGOs, social\-sector organizations, education/healthcare institutions, or multi\-location organizations will be an advantage.
* Good working knowledge of **MS Excel, Word, Google Workspace, and basic documentation systems**.
* Fluency in **Hindi and English**.
* Willingness to travel between centers and field locations in Uttar Pradesh.

Key Skills

* Administration \& Operations Management
* Procurement \& Vendor Coordination
* Inventory \& Asset Management
* Travel \& Logistics Management
* Facility Management
* Documentation \& Record Keeping
* Basic Budget \& Expense Tracking
* MS Excel / Google Sheets
* Communication \& Coordination
* Problem\-solving and follow\-up
* Ability to work independently in field locations

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills.
* Practical, proactive, and solution\-oriented approach.
* Able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* Comfortable coordinating with vendors, employees, field teams, and external stakeholders.
* Willing to travel to **Balrampur, Siddharthnagar, Bhinga, and other UP locations** as required.
* Sensitivity towards persons with disabilities and an understanding of inclusive workplaces is preferred.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely closure of administrative and operational requirements.
* Effective management of center facilities and assets.
* Timely procurement and vendor coordination.
* Accuracy of inventory and asset records.
* Timely completion of travel and event arrangements.
* Proper maintenance of administrative documentation.
* Cost\-effective procurement and operational spending.
* Timely resolution of center\-level operational issues.

description:
**Business HR Associate**

**Department:** Human Resources (Business HR)  
**Designation:** Business HR Associate  
**Reporting To:** Head HR/ Senior Manager – HR / Business Head  
**Location:** Odisha

**Role Summary**

The Business HR Associate will function as a strategic HR business partner responsible for **recruiting, managing, monitoring and driving the productivity of a business team of approximately 20 employees**, including Counsellors, PREs, Marketing Executives and Marketing Interns. The role is highly performance\-oriented and requires continuous field and operational monitoring, employee productivity management, admission and revenue support, and execution of day\-to\-day HR operations.

The position demands **high dedication, strong leadership, discipline, accountability and the ability to work closely with Zonal Heads and business teams** to ensure that employees achieve their assigned targets and contribute directly towards organisational growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1\. Team Management \& Productivity**

* Manage and supervise a team of approximately **20 employees**.
* Ensure daily attendance, discipline, punctuality and work accountability of all mapped employees.
* Monitor employee productivity on an **hourly basis** and maintain real\-time performance tracking.
* Conduct continuous follow\-ups with team members to ensure achievement of daily and weekly targets.
* Identify non\-performing employees and implement corrective actions, counselling and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Ensure strict adherence to reporting timelines and operational discipline.

**2\. Recruitment \& Manpower Planning**

* Recruit Counsellors, PREs, Marketing Executives, Marketing Interns and other business support staff as per manpower requirements.
* Conduct sourcing, screening, interviews, coordination and onboarding of new employees.
* Maintain a continuous talent pipeline to support business expansion across all verticals.
* Ensure timely closure of vacancies and workforce availability.

**3\. Business HR \& Revenue Generation**

* Work closely with the assigned **Zonal Head** and business team to drive admissions and revenue generation.
* Monitor lead generation, field activities, counselling productivity and admission conversions.
* Ensure that the assigned team contributes effectively towards business targets.
* Track team\-wise revenue performance and submit business productivity reports to management.
* Support admission campaigns, marketing drives and institutional growth initiatives across **KTGS, KTHS, IIG Academy, TITE, IIG Sports and IIG Arts Academy**.

**4\. Continuous Monitoring \& Reporting**

* Conduct continuous field and campus monitoring of assigned employees.
* Maintain **hourly reporting** of employee movement, productivity, bookings, admissions and target achievement.
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly and monthly productivity reports.
* Escalate performance deviations and operational issues immediately to the Reporting Manager.
* Ensure accurate documentation of employee performance and business outcomes.

**5\. HR Operations**

* Manage employee attendance, leave records and daily HR coordination.
* Support onboarding, documentation, employee records and HRMS\-related activities.
* Coordinate performance reviews, KRA/KPI implementation and employee evaluation processes.
* Assist in employee engagement, grievance handling and policy communication.
* Ensure compliance with organisational policies and operational procedures.

**6\. Coordination \& Business Support**

* Act as the primary HR point of contact for the assigned Zonal Head and business team.
* Coordinate with Finance, Administration, Operations and Marketing departments for smooth execution of business activities.
* Support fee collection follow\-ups, admission drives and business expansion initiatives wherever required.
* Participate in daily business review meetings and management discussions.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Recruitment closure of assigned positions within defined timelines.
* Productivity of the assigned 20\-member team.
* Admission and revenue contribution of the mapped business team.
* Employee attendance, discipline and reporting compliance.
* Hourly and daily monitoring accuracy.
* Reduction in non\-performing employees.
* Timely submission of productivity and business reports.
* KRA/KPI implementation and performance improvement of assigned employees.

**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* Strong leadership and team management ability.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Recruitment and interviewing skills.
* Employee productivity and performance management expertise.
* Analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and meet aggressive business targets.
* High level of discipline, dedication and accountability.
* Strong follow\-up and monitoring skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, HRMS and reporting tools.

**Qualification**

* MBA / PGDM in HR, Marketing or Business Administration (preferred).
* Graduate with relevant experience may also be considered.

**Experience**

* **1–2 years of experience** in HR, Business HR, Recruitment, Operations or Sales Team Management.
* Experience in **managing field teams, admissions, marketing teams or revenue\-driven operations** will be preferred.

**Working Conditions**

* **Working Hours:** 9:30 AM – 6:30 PM (or as per business requirements).
* **Nature of Work:** Office \+ Field Monitoring.
* **This role requires** travel across all IIG Group offices, campuses and operational locations **Odisha.**

**Compensation**

* Salary: Rs 12,000/\-\-18,000/\-
* Performance\-based growth opportunities.
* Career progression into **Business HR Manager / HR Business Partner** roles.

**Declaration**

This role requires a **highly committed, target\-oriented and business\-focused HR professional** who can independently manage people, improve productivity, monitor operations continuously and directly contribute towards the organisation's admission and revenue growth.

description:

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Purchase Manager** to manage procurement activities for our interior and turnkey projects. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in **project procurement, BOQ, rate analysis, vendor management, material planning, cost control and negotiations**.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the timely availability of quality materials at the best possible prices while maintaining strict control over project\-wise purchase costs, wastage and documentation.

Key Responsibilities1\. Project Material Procurement

* Receive and review material requisitions from the Project/Site Team.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials to project sites.
* Coordinate closely with Project Managers and site teams to understand material requirements and timelines.
* Manage procurement requirements for multiple projects simultaneously.

2\. Vendor Management \& Negotiation

* Identify and develop reliable vendors, suppliers and manufacturers.
* Negotiate the best possible prices, discounts, payment terms and delivery schedules.
* Visit manufacturers and vendor locations as required for material selection, quality verification and commercial negotiations.
* Continuously develop new vendor sources to improve pricing and quality.

3\. BOQ \& Purchase Planning

* Study the **BOQ of every new project** in detail.
* Identify all materials falling under the company's purchase scope.
* Prepare and implement project\-wise purchase plans in coordination with the Project Manager.
* Research new or specialized materials in advance to ensure timely procurement at competitive prices.
* Monitor long\-lead items and ensure advance purchasing wherever required.

4\. Rate Analysis \& Cost Control

* Conduct detailed **rate analysis** for materials and compare market/vendor rates.
* Maintain item\-wise cost benchmarks and monitor material cut\-off costs.
* Negotiate continuously to reduce procurement costs without compromising quality.
* Highlight significant cost variations to management and Project Managers.
* Conduct regular market research to identify better pricing, quality and alternate sources.

5\. Purchase Records \& MIS

* Maintain real\-time records of project\-wise purchases through Excel/software.
* Track purchase orders, quotations, material deliveries, invoices and related documents.
* Prepare project\-wise purchase reports and provide insights on procurement performance.
* Maintain accurate records of material costs for each project.

6\. Material Return \& Wastage Control

* Maintain records of materials returned from project sites.
* Monitor excess ordering, wastage and unnecessary purchases.
* Identify and report material wastage or discrepancies by project teams.
* Escalate irregularities to management immediately.

7\. Purchase Bill Verification

* Strictly verify cash purchase bills submitted by the Project/Site Team.
* Check quantities, rates, material details and supporting documents.
* Ensure bills are genuine, accurate and in accordance with approved purchases.
* Identify discrepancies or irregularities and report them to management.

8\. Continuous Market Research

* Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of market prices for regularly purchased materials.
* Regularly explore new vendors, manufacturers and alternative materials.
* Identify opportunities to improve material quality while reducing costs.
* Continuously benchmark existing purchase rates against current market rates.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Purchase \& Procurement**
* **BOQ understanding and analysis**
* **Rate Analysis**
* Vendor Development \& Vendor Management
* Strong **Negotiation Skills**
* Project Procurement
* Material Planning \& Cost Control
* Knowledge of Interior/Construction Materials
* **Advanced Microsoft Excel**
* Microsoft Word
* Professional Email Writing
* Basic **AutoCAD** knowledge / ability to understand drawings
* Purchase MIS \& Documentation
* Good communication and coordination skills
* Strong attention to detail and commercial understanding

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in the following industries will be preferred:

* Interior Design / Interior Fit\-Out
* Turnkey Projects
* Construction
* Real Estate Projects
* Commercial \& Residential Interior Projects
* Project Procurement

Candidate Profile

* **Experience:** 3–5 years in Purchase/Procurement
* Strong experience in project\-based procurement is preferred.
* Should have hands\-on experience in **BOQ, rate analysis, vendor negotiation and material procurement**.
* Should be comfortable coordinating with Project Managers, site teams, vendors and manufacturers.
* Should be willing to travel to vendor/manufacturer locations whenever required.
* **Good English communication is mandatory.**

Education

title: Production Manager - Garment Unit
description:
Production Manager – Garment Unit

To manage and control the overall garment production operations of the unit and ensure achievement of **production targets, quality standards, productivity, efficiency, manpower utilization, cost objectives and on\-time delivery**.

The Production Manager is responsible for effective production planning and execution, line balancing, manpower deployment, capacity utilization, production performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities A. Production Planning \& Execution

* Ensure daily, weekly and monthly production targets are achieved as per the production plan.
* Convert the production plan into effective line\-wise and operation\-wise execution plans.
* Monitor production against planned quantities and take immediate corrective action for shortfalls.
* Ensure smooth flow of materials from cutting to sewing, finishing, packing and dispatch.
* Coordinate with PPC, IE, Cutting, Quality, Maintenance, Stores and Finishing departments.
* Ensure production priorities are followed according to shipment requirements.
* Monitor WIP at different stages and avoid excess accumulation or line starvation.

B. Line Management \& Capacity Utilization

* Plan and allocate styles/orders to appropriate production lines based on capacity and skill requirements.
* Ensure optimum utilization of sewing lines, machines, manpower and working hours.
* Review line loading and capacity on a daily basis.
* Ensure effective line balancing to achieve required output and efficiency.
* Identify bottleneck operations and take corrective action.
* Ensure smooth style changeover and minimize changeover losses.
* Improve line productivity through effective manpower and machine utilization.

C. Manpower Management

* Ensure optimum deployment of tailors, helpers, checkers, supervisors and other production manpower.
* Monitor daily manpower availability, absenteeism and manpower productivity.
* Work with HR and Training Centre to address manpower shortages.
* Identify skill gaps and arrange appropriate training/retraining.
* Ensure newly trained operators are deployed based on skill level and production requirements.
* Develop and retain competent line supervisors and senior operators.
* Maintain appropriate **Tailor : Non\-Tailor ratio** and continuously improve manpower productivity.

D. Productivity \& Efficiency

* Achieve targeted line efficiency and productivity.
* Monitor hourly production and identify deviations from targets.
* Review operator\-wise and line\-wise productivity.
* Improve machine utilization and reduce idle time.
* Drive productivity improvement initiatives through line balancing, method improvement and operator skill enhancement.
* Work closely with Industrial Engineering to implement SAM/SMV\-based productivity improvements.
* Monitor and reduce production losses, downtime and non\-value\-added activities.

E. Quality Control

* Ensure production is carried out in accordance with approved quality standards and specifications.
* Coordinate closely with Quality Assurance and Quality Control teams.
* Ensure quality issues are identified and corrected at source.
* Minimize DHU, rework, rejection and alteration.
* Ensure operators follow approved methods and quality checkpoints.
* Take corrective action for recurring quality problems.
* Ensure first\-piece approval and style\-wise quality requirements are followed.

F. Delivery \& Shipment

* Ensure production is completed according to the committed shipment schedule.
* Closely monitor critical orders and production status.
* Escalate potential delivery risks immediately to Unit Head/PPC/Management.
* Prioritize production based on shipment urgency and customer requirements.
* Coordinate with finishing and packing teams to ensure timely order completion.

G. Production Performance Monitoring

* Review daily production reports and production KPIs.
* Monitor:
* Planned vs. actual production
* Line efficiency
* Productivity
* DHU/rework
* Absenteeism
* Manpower utilization
* Machine utilization
* WIP
* Rejection
* Downtime
* Changeover time
* On\-time production/delivery
* Conduct daily production review meetings with Line Supervisors and relevant departments.
* Analyse production losses and implement corrective actions.

H. Cost Control

* Control production\-related manpower and operational costs.
* Minimize overtime, rework, rejection, excess manpower and idle time.
* Improve productivity without compromising quality.
* Monitor consumption of production resources and reduce unnecessary wastage.
* Support management in achieving cost\-per\-garment targets.

I. Coordination with Other Departments

Maintain effective coordination with:

* **PPC** – Production planning and order priorities
* **Industrial Engineering** – Capacity, SMV, line balancing and productivity
* **Quality** – Quality standards, DHU, defects and corrective actions
* **Cutting** – Input availability and cutting plan
* **Finishing \& Packing** – Output flow and shipment readiness
* **Maintenance** – Machine breakdowns and preventive maintenance
* **Stores** – Material availability
* **HR** – Manpower planning, attendance, discipline and recruitment
* **Training Centre** – Skill development and operator conversion
* **Commercial/Merchandising** – Order and shipment requirements

Daily Responsibilities

* Review previous day's production performance.
* Review today's production plan and line loading.
* Check manpower availability and absenteeism.
* Review line\-wise targets and hourly production.
* Identify bottlenecks and take immediate action.
* Monitor quality and rework issues.
* Monitor machine breakdowns and downtime.
* Review WIP and material availability.
* Conduct production review with supervisors.
* Ensure critical orders receive appropriate priority.
* Report production status and major issues to Unit Head/DUH.

Weekly / Monthly Responsibilities

* Review production achievement against monthly plan.
* Analyse line\-wise efficiency and productivity.
* Review manpower requirement and deployment.
* Review absenteeism and manpower productivity.
* Analyse quality losses and rework.
* Review machine utilization and downtime.
* Identify productivity improvement opportunities.
* Prepare action plans for underperforming lines.
* Review performance of Production Supervisors and Line Supervisors.
* Support manpower and capacity planning for upcoming orders.
* Participate in monthly business and production review meetings.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The Production Manager should be measured on:

* **Production Plan Achievement – %**
* **Line Efficiency – %**
* **Labour Productivity**
* **Output per Tailor / Operator**
* **DHU / Defect Rate**
* **Rework \& Alteration %**
* **Rejection %**
* **On\-Time Production / Shipment Achievement**
* **Manpower Utilization – %**
* **Absenteeism – %**
* **Machine Utilization – %**
* **Downtime – %**
* **WIP Level**
* **Overtime Control**
* **Cost per Garment**
* **Style Changeover Time**
* **Production Loss / Idle Time**

Required Qualifications

* Diploma / Bachelor's Degree in Garment Technology, Textile Technology, Apparel Production, Industrial Engineering or related discipline.
* Relevant certification in garment production/operations will be an added advantage.

Experience

* **8–12 years of relevant experience** in garment manufacturing.
* Minimum **3–5 years in a supervisory/managerial production role**.
* Experience in handling multiple sewing lines and large production teams preferred.
* Strong experience in woven/knit garment manufacturing, depending on the unit's product profile.

Speedways Electric is a pioneer in the manufacturing of electric vehicles (EVs), specialized in\-campus mobility solutions, luxury golf carts, industrial utility buggies, and customized electric shuttles. Headquartered in Jalandhar, our integrated manufacturing plant produces high\-performance vehicles, battery packs, and specialized components.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an energetic, detail\-oriented **HR Trainee (MBA \- HR)** to join our Plant HR team at the Jalandhar manufacturing facility. * Track shift schedules, overtime (OT), late arrivals, early departures, and leave applications.

**2\. Payroll Support \& Statutory Assistance**

* Assist the HR department in compiling monthly payroll inputs (salaries, deductions, OT, bonuses).
* Coordinate with accounts for timely disbursement of wages.
* Support statutory compliance tracking (PF, ESIC, Factory Act guidelines, and wage registers).

* Review API security, including authentication, authorization, sessions, JWT/OAuth flows, CORS, cookies, and security headers.
* Perform vulnerability assessments using tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nuclei, Nmap, httpx, and Amass.
* Assist with AWS security reviews covering IAM, EC2, RDS, S3, VPC, security groups, load balancers, secrets management, and exposed services.
* Investigate security findings, assess their severity, exploitability, and potential business impact.
* Document vulnerabilities with clear reproduction steps, impact analysis, and remediation recommendations.
* Retest vulnerabilities after fixes are implemented to verify successful remediation.
* Maintain security checklists, vulnerability reports, and internal security documentation.
* Support preparation for external Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) and other security assessments.

title: Warehouse Assistant
description:
**Job Description**

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day operations of the warehouse by ensuring the **accurate receipt, storage, identification, handling, picking, packing and dispatch of materials and products**.

The role requires maintaining proper inventory records, ensuring warehouse cleanliness and safety, supporting stock verification activities, and coordinating with the Warehouse, Purchase, Sales, Accounts and Logistics teams to ensure smooth material movement.

The ideal candidate should be **physically fit, organized, responsible, detail\-oriented and willing to work in a fast\-paced warehouse environment**.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Receiving \& Unloading**

* Receive materials, products and equipment delivered to the warehouse.
* Assist in unloading and safely moving materials to designated storage areas.
* Verify received quantities against invoices, delivery challans, purchase orders or other relevant documents.
* Check materials for visible damage, shortages or discrepancies.
* Immediately report damaged, missing or incorrect materials to the Warehouse Supervisor.
* Ensure received materials are properly identified and tagged before storage.

**B. Storage \& Material Handling**

* Arrange materials systematically in their designated locations.
* Follow the warehouse's storage and stacking procedures.
* Ensure proper labeling and identification of materials.
* Maintain proper segregation of different product categories and materials.
* Handle products carefully to prevent damage, breakage or loss.
* Follow appropriate FIFO/FEFO practices wherever applicable.
* Ensure aisles, emergency exits and movement areas remain clear.

**C. Picking \& Packing**

* Pick materials accurately against approved material requisitions, sales orders or dispatch instructions.
* Verify product codes, descriptions and quantities before dispatch.
* Pack materials securely according to their nature and handling requirements.
* Assist in preparing materials for delivery or dispatch.
* Ensure the correct materials are handed over to the logistics/delivery team.
* Support loading activities while following safe material\-handling practices.

**D. Inventory Management**

* Assist in maintaining accurate physical stock.
* Update stock movement records as instructed.
* Conduct regular physical stock counting.
* Support monthly, periodic and annual stock verification.
* Identify and report stock shortages, excess stock, damaged goods or discrepancies.
* Assist in investigating differences between physical stock and system records.
* Maintain proper documentation for inward and outward movements.

**E. Warehouse Documentation**

* Maintain inward and outward material records.
* Assist with maintaining Goods Receipt Notes (GRN), delivery challans, stock transfer records and other warehouse documents.
* Ensure documents are properly filed and readily available when required.
* Coordinate with the concerned departments regarding pending documentation.
* Maintain accurate records of material movement.

**F. Warehouse Cleanliness \& Organization**

* Maintain cleanliness and proper housekeeping within the warehouse.
* Ensure materials are stored in an organized and accessible manner.
* Follow 5S principles and maintain workplace discipline.
* Remove unnecessary packaging materials and waste from operational areas.
* Ensure products are protected from moisture, dust, heat and other potential sources of damage, wherever applicable.

**G. Safety \& Compliance**

* Follow all warehouse safety procedures and company policies.
* Use appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) when required.
* Follow safe lifting and material\-handling practices.
* Report unsafe conditions, damaged equipment or potential hazards immediately.
* Ensure fire exits, emergency equipment and access routes remain unobstructed.
* Follow company procedures for handling electrical, electronic, energy\-related or other specialized products, wherever applicable.
* Maintain discipline and professional conduct within the warehouse.

**H. Internal Coordination**

Coordinate effectively with:

* Warehouse Supervisor / Manager
* Purchase Department
* Sales Department
* Accounts Department
* Logistics / Delivery Team
* Service / Operations Team
* Other departments as required

**3\. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)**

**KPI**

**Performance Expectation**

**Inventory Accuracy**

Maintain high accuracy between physical and recorded stock

**Picking Accuracy**

Ensure correct product, quantity and specification during picking

**Receiving Accuracy**

Verify incoming materials accurately against documents

**Dispatch Accuracy**

Ensure materials dispatched match approved requirements

**Stock Verification**

Complete assigned stock counts accurately and on time

**Material Handling**

Minimize product damage, loss and mishandling

**Warehouse Organization**

Maintain proper storage, labeling and housekeeping

**Documentation**

Maintain accurate and timely warehouse records

**Safety Compliance**

Follow all applicable warehouse safety procedures

**Timeliness**

Complete assigned warehouse activities within required timelines

**4\. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONMinimum Qualification**

* SSLC / Plus Two / ITI / Diploma or equivalent/ Graduation in any discipline
* Candidates with relevant warehouse experience will be preferred.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Diploma/ITI in Logistics, Supply Chain, Electrical, Mechanical or a related field.
* Certification in warehouse, inventory or logistics operations will be an advantage.

**5\. EXPERIENCE**

**Required Experience:** 0–1 years

Freshers with a positive attitude and willingness to learn may be considered.

Candidates with experience in:

* Warehouse operations
* Inventory management
* Logistics
* Distribution
* Electronics / electrical products
* Solar / energy products
* Consumer durables
* FMCG / retail distribution

will be an added advantage.

**6\. REQUIRED SKILLS \& COMPETENCIESFunctional Skills**

* Basic knowledge of warehouse operations
* Basic inventory management knowledge
* Material handling
* Stock counting and verification
* Picking and packing
* Basic documentation
* Basic computer knowledge
* Ability to read and understand product codes and quantities

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Attention to detail
* Accountability
* Physical fitness
* Teamwork
* Discipline
* Time management
* Reliability
* Willingness to learn
* Ability to follow instructions
* Problem\-solving ability
* Good communication skills
* Positive work attitude

**7\. COMPUTER SKILLS**

The candidate should have basic knowledge of:

* MS Excel
* MS Word
* Email communication
* Basic inventory/ERP software

Experience with warehouse management software, ERP systems or inventory applications will be an advantage.

**8\. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES – DAILY ACTIVITIES**

The Warehouse Assistant may be expected to:

**Start of Day**

* Check warehouse readiness and housekeeping.
* Review pending inward/outward activities.
* Coordinate with the Warehouse Supervisor regarding daily priorities.

**During Operations**

* Receive and verify incoming materials.
* Arrange and label stock.
* Pick materials against approved requirements.
* Pack and prepare materials for dispatch.
* Update relevant records.
* Support stock counting.
* Coordinate with logistics/delivery personnel.

**End of Day**

* Verify pending material movements.
* Ensure materials are properly stored.
* Maintain warehouse cleanliness.
* Secure warehouse areas and materials.
* Report discrepancies or pending activities to the supervisor.

**9\. PHYSICAL \& WORKING REQUIREMENTS**

The position involves an active warehouse environment and may require:

* Standing and walking for extended periods.
* Handling and moving materials.
* Lifting materials within safe and permitted limits.
* Working in indoor and warehouse environments.
* Occasional support during loading and unloading activities.
* Following safety procedures while handling materials.

**Note:** Manual handling should always be performed within applicable safety procedures and the individual's safe lifting capacity.

**10\. REPORTING \& COORDINATIONReports To**

**Warehouse Supervisor / Warehouse Manager**

**Internal Coordination**

* Purchase
* Sales
* Accounts
* Logistics
* Service
* Operations
* Administration

**External Coordination**

* Transporters
* Delivery personnel
* Suppliers/vendors, when assigned
* Customers/authorized representatives, when required

**11\. AUTHORITY \& RESPONSIBILITY**

The Warehouse Assistant is responsible for:

* Safeguarding materials under their assigned responsibility.
* Reporting stock discrepancies immediately.
* Reporting damaged materials immediately.
* Following authorized material movement procedures.
* Maintaining confidentiality of warehouse and company information.
* Not releasing materials without proper authorization/documentation.
* Following company policies, procedures and safety requirements.

**12\. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE**

We are looking for a candidate who is:

**Reliable \| Physically Active \| Organized \| Responsible \| Detail\-Oriented \| Team\-Oriented \| Safety\-Conscious**

The candidate should demonstrate a willingness to take ownership of assigned warehouse activities and maintain accuracy even during periods of high workload.

**13\. CAREER GROWTH**

A potential career progression for this role may be:

**Warehouse Assistant**↓**Senior Warehouse Assistant**↓**Warehouse Executive**↓**Warehouse Supervisor**↓**Warehouse Manager**

Career progression will depend on performance, experience, skill development and organizational requirements.

**14\. EMPLOYEE VALUE PROPOSITION**

At Aldous Glare Tech \& Energy, employees can expect:

* Professional and structured work environment
* Opportunities to learn warehouse and logistics operations
* Exposure to inventory and supply\-chain processes
* Performance\-based career development
* Team\-oriented working environment
* Opportunities for increased responsibility based on performance

**15\. APPLICATION DETAILS**

**Position:** Warehouse Assistant**Location:** Kurumassery, Kochi, Kerala

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Experience:** 0–1 Years

**Salary:** ₹18000**\-**20000 per month

**ABOUT ALDOUS GLARE TECH \& ENERGY**

Establishes in 1995, for the past 31 years, Aldous Glare Tech \& Energy **(AGTE)** has successfully stood the test of time, establishing itself as a brand synonymous with trust and quality. In the ever\-evolving landscape of technology, we operate with the primary goal of increasing accessibility and awareness of the latest tech gadgets and appliances. We create opportunities for our channel partners through aggressive market development and continuous improvements achieved through agility.

Aldous Glare Tech and Energy **(AGTE)** is a technology product distribution company headquartered in Cochin, with branches in Trivandrum, Thrissur, and Calicut. Aldous Glare is India's leading distributor for smartphones, Android TVs, Google TVs, Smart ACs, Washing machines, solar products, and cloud services.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹21,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Influencer Marketing Operation Executive
description:
About Lakyou Beauty

Lakyou Beauty is a growing beauty and personal care brand focused on creating high\-quality, trend\-driven makeup and beauty products for the modern Indian consumer.

We are looking for a **highly organized and detail\-oriented Influencer Marketing Operations Executive** to manage the backend and operational execution of our influencer marketing activities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys **coordination, documentation, Excel/Google Sheets, shipping, invoices, follow\-ups and keeping campaigns organized**.

Role Overview

The Influencer Marketing Operations Executive will be responsible for ensuring that influencer campaigns run smoothly from an operational perspective.

The candidate will work closely with the **Influencer Marketing, Finance, Warehouse, Marketing and Logistics teams** to ensure products are dispatched on time, campaign documentation is accurate, invoices are properly maintained, and influencer deliverables and payments are tracked.

**This is primarily an execution and backend operations role, not a creative/content creation role.**

Key Responsibilities1\. Influencer Campaign Operations

* Maintain and update the influencer campaign database.
* Record influencer details, campaign status, product allocation, deliverables and payment information.
* Create and maintain campaign trackers in **Google Sheets / MS Excel**.
* Track every influencer from onboarding to campaign completion.
* Maintain records of:
* Influencer name
* Contact details
* Instagram/YouTube profile
* Product sent
* Shipment details
* Campaign type
* Deliverables
* Posting date
* Payment status
* Invoice status
* Campaign status

2\. Shiprocket \& Product Dispatch

* Handle day\-to\-day **Shiprocket operations** for influencer shipments.
* Create shipping orders for influencers.
* Enter and verify influencer shipping addresses.
* Select the appropriate product/SKU and shipment details.
* Generate shipping labels and AWBs.
* Coordinate with the warehouse/team for product dispatch.
* Track shipments and delivery status.
* Follow up on delayed, failed or returned shipments.
* Maintain a record of all influencer shipments.
* Coordinate re\-shipping wherever required.
* Ensure products reach influencers within the campaign timeline.

3\. Influencer Invoices \& Payment Coordination

* Collect invoices from influencers/creators.
* Verify invoice details before submitting them for payment.
* Maintain an **Influencer Invoice Tracker**.
* Check influencer name, PAN, bank details, invoice amount, invoice number and campaign details.
* Coordinate with the Finance team for payment processing.
* Track pending, submitted and paid invoices.
* Follow up internally on pending payments.
* Maintain proper documentation for every influencer payment.
* Match invoices with approved campaign commercials and deliverables.
* Flag discrepancies in invoice amounts or payment details.

4\. Campaign Documentation

* Maintain complete documentation for every influencer collaboration.
* Organize campaign briefs, approvals, invoices, shipping details and payment records.
* Maintain proper Google Drive folders and campaign files.
* Ensure all campaign\-related documents are updated and easily accessible.
* Maintain proper naming conventions and documentation standards.

5\. Influencer Follow\-Ups

* Follow up with influencers for:
* Address details
* Product requirements
* Content submissions
* Posting dates
* Invoice submission
* Bank details
* Pending deliverables
* Send reminders to influencers regarding pending campaign requirements.
* Escalate delayed deliverables to the Influencer Marketing Manager.

6\. Campaign Deliverable Tracking

* Maintain a daily tracker of influencer deliverables.
* Track whether content has been:
* Briefed
* Product delivered
* Content received
* Approved
* Posted
* Link/report submitted
* Maintain screenshots/links of published content where required.
* Ensure no influencer campaign is left pending without follow\-up.

7\. Reporting \& MIS

Prepare regular reports and trackers covering:

* Total influencers onboarded
* Products dispatched
* Products delivered
* Pending shipments
* Pending content
* Content published
* Pending invoices
* Payments processed
* Pending payments
* Campaign\-wise spending
* Influencer\-wise spending
* Product\-wise gifting
* Monthly campaign status

Provide daily/weekly updates to the Influencer Marketing Manager.

8\. Coordination With Internal Teams

Coordinate closely with:

**Influencer Marketing Team**  
For campaign requirements, influencer details and deliverables.

**Warehouse Team**  
For product availability, packing and dispatch.

**Finance Team**  
For invoices, payments and documentation.

**Marketing Team**  
For campaign timelines and reporting.

**Logistics Team**  
For shipment\-related issues and returns.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **MS Excel / Google Sheets**
* Good understanding of basic formulas, filters, sorting and data management
* Experience using **Shiprocket or other shipping/logistics platforms**
* Good understanding of invoices and basic payment documentation
* Excellent follow\-up skills
* Strong attention to detail
* Good written and verbal communication
* Ability to manage multiple influencers and campaigns simultaneously
* Good organizational and time\-management skills
* Comfortable working with large spreadsheets and repetitive operational tasks
* Ability to identify errors in data, invoices and campaign information
* Good email and WhatsApp communication skills

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be preferred:

* Influencer marketing
* Creator management
* D2C brands
* Beauty / cosmetics / skincare / fashion
* E\-commerce operations
* Marketing operations
* Campaign coordination
* Logistics operations
* Shiprocket
* Invoice management
* Finance coordination

Experience with **Tally, Zoho Books, Shopify, Google Drive and other e\-commerce tools** will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:

* **Highly organized**
* Extremely detail\-oriented
* Good with numbers and documentation
* Comfortable doing backend operational work
* Strong at follow\-ups
* Responsible with deadlines
* Good at Excel/Google Sheets
* Quick at learning new software
* Comfortable coordinating with multiple teams
* Proactive rather than waiting for instructions
* Able to manage repetitive tasks without losing accuracy

Important:

**This role requires strong execution and operational discipline.**

The candidate should enjoy working with **trackers, spreadsheets, invoices, shipping portals, documentation and follow\-ups** rather than looking primarily for a creative/social\-media role.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Accuracy of influencer database
* Timely creation of Shiprocket shipments
* Shipment delivery success rate
* Accuracy of influencer addresses
* Timely invoice collection
* Accuracy of invoice documentation
* Timely payment coordination
* Percentage of campaigns completed on schedule
* Number of pending influencer deliverables
* Response/follow\-up efficiency
* Accuracy of daily and weekly reports
* Overall campaign operational efficiency

Qualification

* Graduate in B.Com, BBA, Marketing, Business Administration or any relevant field.
* **1–3 years of relevant experience preferred.**
* Freshers with strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and excellent organizational ability may also be considered.

title: People Operations Manager
description:

 Techdome is a fast\-growing Product Venture. As
 **People Operations Manager** 
 , you'll lead the People Operations team and own the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding to exit — while driving HRMS management, payroll, compliance, performance cycles, and policy governance for a scaling tech organization.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and manage the People Operations team, guiding day\-to\-day execution, delegating effectively, and building team capability.
* Own end\-to\-end employee lifecycle operations: onboarding, confirmations, transfers, and exit/offboarding formalities.
* Maintain and administer the HRMS/HRIS (Keka preferred), employee records, and documentation with accuracy and confidentiality.
* Administer attendance, leave, and time\-tracking; support end\-to\-end payroll processing in coordination with finance.
* Drive the performance management cycle — goal\-setting, appraisals, calibration — and coordinate salary hikes/increments and compensation reviews.
* Ensure statutory and labour\-law compliance (PF, ESI, gratuity, professional tax, related filings) and own grievance resolution with discretion, fairness, and timely closure.
* Create new HR policies and update existing ones, along with SOPs, HR letters, and the employee handbook.
* Support employee engagement activities, events, and internal communications.
* Serve as an escalation point for employee queries on policies, benefits, and processes.
* Generate People Ops reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, onboarding TAT) for leadership.
* Coordinate with recruitment, finance, and IT for smooth pre\- and post\-joining processes.
* Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude) to streamline HR documentation, reporting, and process efficiency.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

* 3–8 years of experience in HR operations, HR generalist, or HR shared\-services roles (IT/tech industry preferred), including experience leading or supervising a team.
* Proven end\-to\-end HR operations ownership across the full employee lifecycle.
* Hands\-on HRMS experience is mandatory — Keka strongly preferred; other platforms (Zoho People, Darwinbox, GreytHR, etc.) acceptable if Keka exposure isn't available.
* Experience creating new HR policies and updating existing ones is mandatory.
* Payroll processing support is mandatory.
* Performance appraisal cycle and compensation/hike management experience is mandatory.
* Strong working knowledge of Indian labour laws, statutory compliance, and grievance management.
* Practical experience using AI tools (such as Claude) in HR work is mandatory.
* Strong MS Excel / Google Sheets skills and comfort with HR reporting.
* Excellent communication, discretion, and organizational skills.


 Good to Have
   

  

* Exposure to a high\-growth or startup environment.
* Familiarity with L\&D coordination and employee engagement program design.


 What We Look For
   

  

 A people\-first, hands\-on leader who can manage a team while staying close to execution — balancing process, compliance, and empathy, driving performance and compensation cycles fairly, and using modern AI tools to work smarter in a fast\-paced, growing organization.

 We are looking for an experienced Human Resources Manager to manage end\-to\-end HR operations, payroll, statutory compliance, recruitment, performance management, employee engagement and HR MIS.

* 8\-10 years of overall HR experience

**Key Responsibilities** 



* End\-to\-end payroll processing for 300\+ employees

* Performance Management System, compensation \& benefits and employee engagement
* Training \& Development and measuring training effectiveness

* Graduation in any discipline
* PG / MBA in Human Resources preferred
* Advanced course in HR / OD will be an advantage

**Advanced Excel \| End\-to\-End Payroll \| TDS \| PF / EPF \| ESIC \| PT \| LWF \| Gratuity \| Leave Encashment \| Leave Accrual \| Maternity Compliance \| POSH \| HRMS \| HR MIS \| Labour Compliance \| Team Management**

description:
Alation is pioneering the next era of
 **data intelligence — powered by AI agents and trusted data** 
 . Organizations around the world rely on
 **Alation** 
 to drive self\-service analytics, cloud transformation, data governance, and AI innovation. Our technology helps enterprises connect people and data to make faster, smarter, and more confident decisions. With more than $340M in funding – valued at over $1\.7 billion and more than 650 customers, including 40% of the Fortune 100\.
   

  

 As data becomes the foundation of every business, Alation is leading the way in helping organizations unlock their full potential. By bringing intelligence, automation, and trust to every interaction, we empower customers to scale data\-driven innovation with confidence and speed.
   

  

 Joining Alation means being part of a
 **winning team shaping the future of AI\-powered data intelligence** 
 . We move fast, think big, and deliver results together.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role**
 Alation is looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our global People team and serve as a key HR partner for our Alationauts across the company This is a high\-impact, fast\-paced role sitting at the intersection of HR operations, employee experience, and systems excellence. You'll keep the engine running — owning core HR processes, ensuring our data is accurate and our people feel supported — while partnering closely with our HRBPs and cross\-functional teams to scale our programs globally.
   

  

 If you're someone who thrives in ambiguity, loves solving problems, and finds meaning in delivering a genuinely great employee experience, this role is for you.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
**People Operations**
* Own day\-to\-day HR operations including onboarding/offboarding, benefits administration for India, support payroll inquiries, immigration coordination, and intranet maintenance.
* Serve as a trusted first point of contact for employee inquiries — responding promptly, troubleshooting effectively, and escalating when needed through the companies ticketing system (e.g., JIRA, Serval)
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, IT, Payroll, and HRBPs to deliver a seamless, "red carpet" experience at every touchpoint of the employee lifecycle.
* Respond to employment verification requests and manage related documentation with accuracy and timeliness.
* Conduct periodic compliance and benefits audits; identify gaps and recommend process improvements.
* Maintain high standards of data integrity across HR systems — ensuring records are accurate, up\-to\-date, and audit\-ready.
* Pull reports, process data changes, and prepare workforce analytics for managers and business partners.
* Contribute to special projects and initiatives that support People team priorities.


**What You Bring**
**Experience \& Skills**
* 5\+ years of experience in HR operations or a generalist HR role.
* Hands\-on experience with Workday (strongly preferred) — including HCM, reporting, and data management; understanding of how HR modules integrate across a broader system ecosystem.
* Strong working knowledge of Google Suite (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Forms).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor your message to different audiences.
* Proven ability to handle sensitive, confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
* Sharp organizational skills and strong attention to detail, even when juggling competing priorities.
* Comfort with ambiguity — you can pivot quickly without losing your footing.


 Competencies
   

  

* Integrity — You handle sensitive information with care. Confidentiality isn't a checkbox for you; it's a core value.
* Collaboration — You build genuine relationships across all levels of the organization and know how to get things done through partnership, not just process.
* Initiative — You don't wait to be told what needs fixing. You spot it, own it, and follow through.
* Adaptability — Priorities shift and you roll with it. You're comfortable re\-prioritizing on the fly and maintaining a positive, can\-do attitude.
* Communication — You know what to say and, more importantly, how to say it. You're a good listener and genuinely open to other perspectives.
* Analytical Thinking — You can turn raw data into meaningful insight, supporting sound decisions for managers and the broader People team.
* Technical Savvy — You can troubleshoot functional and technical issues in HR systems, with Workday experience at the top of your toolkit.
* Service Mindset — You care about the people you support. Every interaction is an opportunity to build trust and deliver a great experience.
